“That old man who is trying to ruin the main sect by using his seniority as a weapon will die by my hand. So do not worry and go back. Do you not know what kind of person I am?”

“I do. Junior Brother was a man who always kept his word once he gave it.”

“Let us meet again next time, Senior Brother.”

Geugak Soma’s senior martial brother shouted to the disciples.

“We return!”

The disciples of the White Mask Sect leapt away, following him.

I was truly impressed by Geugak Soma’s calm response. It was the moment I saw a new side of him.

—To finish this without a single sacrifice. Since meeting you, Lord Soma, that was your most impressive moment.

—You think it was impressive that Geugak Soma did not see blood? That feels rather strange.

Perhaps he too was changing after meeting me.

“Those useless fools!”

As Yang Cheogi exploded in anger, Geugak Soma said as if mocking him,

“It seems I am more fortunate in senior martial brothers than our master was.”

“Shut up!”

At Yang Cheogi’s irritated reaction, I added a word of my own.

“They left because they hate you. They probably came here only because they were forced to obey your command. How much must they have hated you to listen to Lord Soma, who left the sect long ago? How could they not know that you were trying to drag the disciples to their deaths merely because you are an elder of the sect? You had best simply die here today.”

Yang Cheogi gave a sneer.

“I knew you killed the Sword Emperor. Did you think I would face you alone? I have kept you waiting long enough. Eccentric Demon, please come out now.”

Then a person appeared from inside the building across the road. He was an old man who had not aged gracefully. Malice filled the gaps between his wrinkled folds, and his eyes were full of nothing but killing intent.

At the name Eccentric Demon, I was startled.

He was a demonic practitioner who had learned demonic arts, but did not belong to our cult.

He was famous for having used demonic arts to commit massacres wherever he went, until in the end, our cult and the Murim Alliance cooperated to form an execution squad to kill him. After that, he had vanished, and today he had revealed himself.

I asked Yang Cheogi,

“Just who have you joined hands with? Who did you join hands with for even the Eccentric Demon to come crawling out?”

But before I could hear an answer, the Eccentric Demon stepped forward with a cold gaze.

“Crawling out? You little bastard has quite a foul way of speaking. Is that how your father taught you?”

He mentioned my parents in this situation? And my father, no less?

“It is because old men act so shamelessly like this that the old masters of murim have fewer and fewer places to stand. You came out to kill us, yet you expect courtesy too? Very well, from now on, I will give you all the courtesy in the world. It is an honor to meet you, Senior. Please, for the sake of our bond as fellow demonic practitioners, spare this insignificant junior! Now then, will you spare me?”

The Eccentric Demon could not answer, and the corner of one eye twitched.

“So please stop spouting nonsense about courtesy. Where did you suddenly crawl out from to start this bullshit?”

I deliberately provoked him strongly. They had come here to kill us anyway. In that case, the more I provoked him, the more advantageous it would be in the fight. The more it was a fight between experts, the more one lost if emotions interfered. The reason he had mentioned my father to make me flare up was probably along the same lines.

Yang Cheogi said to the Eccentric Demon,

“Break every bone in his body. Let us see if he can still act that arrogant then.”

“Annoying. Watch carefully in advance. In a little while, he will disappear without even leaving a shape behind.”

No matter how terrible their characters were, in terms of martial arts, both of them were close to the Sword Emperor Baek Manggi. If the two of us faced one person together, it might be one thing, but facing two of them was no easy matter.

It was right then.

Clank, clank.

The sound of chains came from somewhere.

When I turned, a man with a sturdy build appeared, a blood-red chain wrapped around his wrist and hanging down as he dragged it along the ground.

“Iron Chain Master!”

He was a villain called Iron Chain Master, a man who had once plunged murim into terror. Who knew how many experts had lost their lives with their bodies bursting apart under that red chain of his? His aura was also no less than that of the Eccentric Demon who had appeared earlier.

At his appearance, my heart sank. Facing the two before him would not have been easy to begin with. But now even Iron Chain Master had appeared, placing us in an absolutely disadvantageous situation.

I said to Geugak Soma with a sigh,

“This is all my fault.”

“Elder Blood Heaven Saber Demon said it. That I would stir up storms and wake up all sorts of hidden masters. I really did not think I would end up meeting the Eccentric Demon and Iron Chain Master here.”

“This time, I think it was I, not the Second Young Master, who woke them.”

“Then please take the stronger one, Lord Soma.”

Seeing that I did not forget to joke even in this situation, the two eyes behind the mask smiled. It was the worst possible situation, but perhaps because I was with Geugak Soma, my heart felt strangely reassured.

“Ah, before that, I must ask this first.”

I looked at Yang Cheogi and said,

“Which side will you join to attack us together?”

Of course, I had thrown out the question with the intention of stopping him from joining in.

Yang Cheogi smiled leisurely.

“You do not have to prod my pride like that. I will not step forward. Now, we should look well at our Second Young Master’s face and body. Soon, he will become a bloody pulp and disappear.”

Since the Eccentric Demon intended to face me, Geugak Soma’s opponent naturally became Iron Chain Master.

I thought it had worked out well. Both the Eccentric Demon and Iron Chain Master were formidable foes, but I expected the Eccentric Demon to be slightly stronger.

I looked at Geugak Soma.

I did not ask if he was confident. That would have been an insult to Geugak Soma. Until the very end, I displayed my composure.

“Let us make a bet on who kills first.”

At my words, the Eccentric Demon laughed. Iron Chain Master laughed, and Yang Cheogi laughed as well.

“I do not know why those things are laughing when even Lord Soma is staying still.”

Only then did Geugak Soma laugh too, and lastly, I laughed as well.

When I drew my sword and let it hang, Geugak Soma lightly flicked the blade of the Black Demon Sword with his finger.

Tiiing!

Listening to the clear metallic sound that carried Geugak Soma’s wish for us to fight well, I walked forward toward the most difficult battle I had faced since my regression.

Chapter 148: If I Feel Like I’m Going to Die
--------------------------------------------
I controlled my mind.

With a powerful enemy before me, I couldn't afford to worry about Geukak Soma. I had to focus solely on my own fight. I would trust Geukak Soma. Instead, I had to keep my eye on Yangcheogi.

Because he was someone who could jump in and launch a surprise attack at any moment.

Goema donned gloves fitted with claws split like fingers on both hands. It was his exclusive weapon, the Heavenfall Flying Claws. A chilling azure gleam ran along the blades.

"Shall we see if your blade can keep up with that sharp tongue?"

Kaack! Kak! Kaaaack!

With bizarre whistling sounds, the Heavenfall Flying Claws tore through the air. It was an attack that would rip away flesh and bone with just a graze.

Clang! Clang! Chaeng! Clang!

My sword and the Heavenfall Flying Claws clashed countless times. I struggled to widen the distance, while he desperately tried to close in. After all, since the Heavenfall Flying Claws were shorter than my sword, the closer he got, the more advantageous it was for him.

Amidst the bone-chilling exchange of offense and defense, I met that moment.

Just as when I had fought Baekmanggi, I saw only Goema.

The surroundings fell silent, and I heard only our movements and sounds. I felt the illusion that even time was flowing slowly. But time never flowed slowly. My focus had merely heightened to such a degree.

Right then, a short scream tore through the silence!

"Keuk!"

The instant I realized the one who had screamed was Geukak Soma.

Flash.

Swhiiik.

The iron chain that had been aimed at the staggering, retreating Geukak Soma turned toward me.

Swhiiiik!

Taeng!

The moment my sword struck Cheolsweja's iron chain and deflected away, I sensed a rushing force from behind and twisted my body to dodge.

Goema's Heavenfall Flying Claws raked through the space where I had just been.

Geukak Soma, having narrowly escaped danger thanks to me, launched his Hyeorangji at Goema, who was pressing a second attack on me.

Swhiiiing.

Goema likewise twisted his body to evade the Hyeorangji.

In the past, failing a mission simply meant the end. Since the restriction on Geukak Soma hadn't been released, such a situation couldn't have occurred in the first place.

The Heavenfall Flying Claws ripped space apart, and Cheolsweja's iron chain reared its head like a living serpent and lunged.

Tung!

Teong! Tung!

Swish-rip!

The moment the sword qi blades were completed!

Swhiiing! Swish!

Fwaak!

At that critical moment when his internal energy ran out and his movements grew drastically sluggish.

Sssut.

We were now inside the world of the Spacetime Transference Technique.

If I'm struggling, you must be struggling too. If I feel like I'm dying, you must feel like you're dying too. I don't believe it. That you worked harder than me. I believed in myself, and I believed in all my effort.

Shick! Puoook!

Cheolsweja, like someone who absolutely cannot endure an itch and must scratch it, yanked the dagger out of his throat.

Puoook!

Piing! Peoek!

Chapter 149: The Trial Continues.

Extreme Evil Young Demon, what about you? Do you feel the same as I do?

That’s right. Drink with the Drunken Demon, laugh with the Young Demon. That was enough.

The Blood Heaven Blade Demon stared at me for a moment, then abruptly turned and walked away. The Extreme Evil Young Demon followed behind him.

“There you go again. There you go again.”

I walked after them and left the place.

“Look into it.”

“Yes! The Cheonmyeong Society is more troublesome than we had thought.”

Until now, they had regarded the Cheonmyeong Society as little more than a group that impersonated the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult to seek illicit profit. But now that they saw more clearly, it was an organization far larger and stronger than that.

“What will you do? It may be too much for the Second Young Master to handle. Shall we call him back now?”

But Geom Ujin shook his head.

“That mission is one the child chose himself, is it not? Then he must bear it. Instead, overlook the Demon Venerables’ involvement this time. And increase the cult’s support from one instance to three.”

“Understood.”

Originally, it was a mission he was supposed to carry out alone, so it should not have been permissible for the Demon Venerables to intervene like this.

But since a special situation beyond the scope of the trial had unfolded, they would adjust the difficulty accordingly.

“I will focus our pavilion’s information network on monitoring the Cheonmyeong Society.”

Geom Ujin nodded and said,

“Tell my second son that the trial continues.”

* * *

We stayed at one of the cult’s safe houses not far from the Yellow River Inn, where the fight had taken place.

For several days, we rested, recovered our inner force, and treated our wounds. We ate proper meals, circulated our qi, regulated our breathing, and rested fully.

And today, a message arrived from the Heavenly Demon Hall telling me to continue the mission.

As expected of Father, I thought. Even if I sent a message saying I was about to wage a battle against the Murim Alliance, he would be the kind of man to reply, “Fight well.”

That night, as I strolled through the garden of the safe house, enjoying the lonely moonlight, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon was training in martial arts in the yard off to one side.

“You train even here?”

“Do you think training is a game? Why would I care about the place?”

“These days, whenever I see you, Elder, I find myself thinking that becoming a Demon Venerable is no joke.”

“Don’t lie. You look down on us.”

“That’s a misunderstanding!”

To be honest, when I first resolved to win over the Demon Venerables, I had looked down on them. But as I grew closer to them, I had long since abandoned that thought. These people were absolutely not simple.

That was probably why Yang Cheogi had failed to become a Demon Venerable.

Separate from his martial skill, he lacked something decisive that would allow him to become a Demon Venerable. Should I say he had no charm? No presence? That he was not of that caliber? There was something missing in him.

“I suppose because I’ve only been seeing the Drunken Demon drinking every day, I’d forgotten how frightening Demon Venerables are.”

“You mustn’t look down on that drunkard either.”

“Why have you been worrying about me so much lately?”

“Do you look like someone I shouldn’t worry about? Every chance you get, you fall into danger like this. At this rate, I’ll have to empty my pocket money and buy you another protective robe. By the way, what about the Sokgong Pill?”

“I took it.”

I did not say that I had fed it to the Extreme Evil Young Demon. If I did, our old man might fume all night and be unable to sleep.

That was when it happened.

“I was the one who took it.”

I turned and saw the Extreme Evil Young Demon walking out into the garden.

“Thanks to it, I survived.”

Then he bowed his head lightly. At that respectful attitude, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon merely shot me a look and did not say anything to needles the Extreme Evil Young Demon for no reason.

“As long as you’re safe, that’s enough.”

How desperate must the situation have been for him to swallow that and keep fighting? How could the Blood Heaven Blade Demon not understand? Behind his back, he cursed the Extreme Evil Young Demon as a sinister bastard all the time, but he still acknowledged his skill.

“I’ll repay this debt next time.”

“Before that, you should wipe the blood off that mask.”

“I intend to wear it as is until this matter is over.”

I sensed that the Extreme Evil Young Demon was slightly excited. It was not merely anger. It was closer to the exhilaration one felt after surviving a life-and-death battle for the first time in a long while.

I felt the same. In the final fight, I had experienced my sword moving faster than before. It had come from my desperation to save the Extreme Evil Young Demon, but in any case, I had surpassed the limit I could reach. That was what mattered. The fact that I had broken through a limit. Since the Flying Heaven Sword Art had already reached the great completion of the twelfth star, this improvement must be related to the overall realm of my martial learning.

“I brushed against death more than once, but honestly, it felt incredible.”

At my words, the eyes behind the Extreme Evil Young Demon’s mask showed agreement.

Even the Blood Heaven Blade Demon nodded.

“It’s that taste that drives everyone mad.”

It seemed the Blood Heaven Blade Demon’s blood had also begun to boil when he exchanged that palm strike with Yang Cheogi.

“First, we have to catch Yang Cheogi.”

Yang Cheogi had not only tried to kill us; he had also attempted to drive the disciples of the White Mask Sect, the Extreme Evil Young Demon’s own sect, to their deaths. Since he would continue targeting the Extreme Evil Young Demon and me in the future, he had to be dealt with first.

“Moreover, he must have met the leader of the Cheonmyeong Society in person, so he will also be useful in finding him.”

At that, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon asked,

“Do you know where that Yang Cheogi fellow is?”

“He’ll be hiding in Evil Valley. The people he brought out from there are dead, so he’ll have to report it, and it’s also the safest place for him. Besides, Yang Cheogi is aiming for the position of Master of Evil Valley, so he must have returned there.”

“I’ll help you.”

When the Blood Heaven Blade Demon said he would help, the Extreme Evil Young Demon unexpectedly spoke up.

“I know Evil Valley well.”

After a brief pause, he added,

“I was there once.”

I was startled and asked,

“When were you there?”

“When I was young. My master sent me there, saying I should cultivate a wicked heart. He came to retrieve me three years later.”

“What if you had died there?”

“Then he would have found another disciple.”

“You survived in Evil Valley at such a young age?”

The Extreme Evil Young Demon nodded.

“Evil Valley is ultimately a place where people live. If there are experts like the Monster Demon, there are also people who know no martial arts at all. There are even people who are not from Evil Valley but bring goods in bulk and do business there, because the profit margin is high. Still, you must not let your guard down. If you enter without any information, there is no place as terrifying as Evil Valley.”

I relayed to the two of them the contents of the message that had come from the cult.

“The cult contacted me today. The mission to eliminate the leader of the Cheonmyeong Society remains in effect, and instead, support has been strengthened so that I may receive aid from the cult three times. I think we should use one of those chances now. The three of us could handle it, but in the process, the Master of Evil Valley may step forward. There is no need to take unnecessary risks. In any case, it only means using one opportunity.”

With the spirit of wiping out Evil Valley entirely if need be, I spoke powerfully.

“Let’s call the One Flower Sword Venerable and the Great Drunken Demon too, and go catch Yang Cheogi.”

Chapter 150: The Good Must Die.
-------------------------------
The Master of Villains’ Valley, Ji Fangyin, was so furious he could hardly bear it.

“You expect me to believe that?”

“What’s there to believe or not believe? It’s simply what happened.”

“The two great masters of Villains’ Valley do not simply die at the same time.”

Short in stature, with gloomy eyes, Ji Fangyin had always possessed the sort of presence that dampened a person’s spirits. Now that his temper had turned, the air around him grew so stifling it was hard to breathe.

“Can you defeat the Strange Demon? Are you confident you can defeat the Iron Chain Master? I’m not. And neither are you, are you? So how am I supposed to believe that those two were killed by the Extreme Evil Young Demon? In the same place, no less! Together!”

“It wasn’t because of the Extreme Evil Young Demon. It was because of the Second Young Master of the Demon Cult.”

“You call that an explanation?”

It was only natural that voices were rising. The Master of Villains’ Valley knew nothing of Geom Mugeuk’s strength. Only those in the murim who dealt in the most secretive information knew that Geom Mugeuk’s martial prowess was far greater than expected; his true abilities had yet to become known to the world.

“And was it only them? Did we not send the Paradise Enchantress, the Three Lords of the Bloody Road, the Blood Wolf Blade, and the Yama Divine Lord as well? Yet you say they were all annihilated, and you alone came back alive!”

“I barely made it back alive! I nearly died, I tell you.”

“Do you know something? Your words are so absurd that they almost sound like the truth. Surely you wouldn’t be stupid enough to offer such a ridiculous excuse.”

The Master of Villains’ Valley simply could not believe this situation. Through this affair, he had lost the two strongest limbs at his disposal. He had sent them all out precisely so that no one would die.

“When they died, what were you doing, Great Hero Yang?”

“When I was about to step in, the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon appeared. That old man’s internal energy was so profound that there was nothing I could do.”

Yang Cheogi thoroughly concealed the fact that he had only stepped in after the Strange Demon and the Iron Chain Master had died. The Valley Master would suspect him and investigate every which way, but in the end he would have no choice but to believe him. After all, it was an undeniable fact that on that day, only Geom Mugeuk, the Extreme Evil Young Demon, and the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon had been there.

“I, too, have ties with the Lord of the Heavenly Mandate Society. Why would I ruin this? Please believe me.”

The Master of Villains’ Valley regretted it. Had he known things would turn out this way, he would never have joined hands with the Lord of the Heavenly Mandate Society. Only now did it occur to him that the sweet thing the man had offered might in fact have been poison. Greed was always the root of disaster.

What was past was past. The present problem was this: with their deaths, his own position as Valley Master had become precarious.

Of all the organizations in the murim, Villains’ Valley was the one whose leader changed the quickest. It was filled with people who would bare their fangs the moment they sensed weakness in their head.

‘If you’ve been scheming for my seat, you won’t die a clean death.’

Ordinarily, even if Ji Fangyin harbored such thoughts, he would not reveal them on the outside. He was the sort of man who always smiled at enemies he intended to kill.

But today, he could not suppress his anger.

“I don’t want to see your face. Withdraw for now. We’ll speak again later.”

“Very well.”

Yang Cheogi was about to turn away when the Master of Villains’ Valley spoke.

“Do you know what my byname was before I entered this place?”

“What was it?”

“Hundred Evils. They called me that because I possessed every evil in the world.”

“Is that so?”

That indifferent response only angered the Master of Villains’ Valley further. Whether he knew that or not, Yang Cheogi threw out a new concern.

“They’ll guess that I’m here.”

“What are you trying to say? That they may even come charging all the way into this valley?”

“It’s not impossible.”

In this way, Yang Cheogi blocked off the possibility that the Master of Villains’ Valley might try to kill him.

“Since you came back after cutting off both our arms, we’ll have to fight with only our feet. If what you say is true, then we’re all dead now.”

Of course, he did not mean it sincerely. If Villains’ Valley would collapse simply because those two were gone, then it would have disappeared long ago. This was a place teeming with countless villains driven to the end of the road.

No one in the jianghu would immerse themselves in this filthy water. Just as it had always been.

After Yang Cheogi left, the Master of Villains’ Valley summoned a subordinate and issued an order.

“Investigate this matter thoroughly. And from this moment on, kill every person who enters the valley. Let everyone know! We’ll pay fifty thousand taels for each intruder’s head.”

* * *

After sending a letter to the main cult requesting the Drunken Demon and the One-Flower Sword Venerable, we headed straight for Villains’ Valley.

Lightness skill was faster than riding horses, so we ran using lightness skill.

A journey running alongside the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon and the Extreme Evil Young Demon? It was something I had never imagined, not before my regression, and not even after it.

I had traveled with the Extreme Evil Young Demon before, but this was my first time with the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon. On this journey, I learned something new about him.

The Blood-Heaven Blade Demon, whom I had thought would only like shutting himself in a room and reading books, had unexpectedly been to almost every corner of the Central Plains. Whenever we came upon an area he knew, he would stop mid-run and tell us about it.

“If you go over that mountain, you’ll reach a large place called Joyapyeong. There, I exchanged five hundred moves with a wandering swordsman who challenged me. That was when I was in the prime of my youth.”

Stories of battles he had fought, like this.

“In that village over there, there is a sect made up solely of women. Its sect master and her chief disciple both fell in love with me.”

He also spoke such absurd, lie-like stories with perfect nonchalance. At that moment, the Extreme Evil Young Demon and I sent voice transmissions to each other at the exact same time: He’s lying.

“From beyond that side lies the sphere of influence of the Evil Alliance. If you travel eight hundred li in that direction, you’ll reach the territory of the Murim Alliance.”

He was also well-versed in geography and the state of the murim.

There were many moments when I wanted to chime in because his words overlapped with what I knew, but I forced myself to hold back.

“By the way, was your internal energy always this profound?”

Seeing that I was not falling behind at all while running with them, the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon looked puzzled.

“I once took a spiritual medicine gifted to me by a very noble person.”

That spiritual medicine was none other than the Heaven-Outside Divine Pill the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon had given me before.

“That alone shouldn’t allow you to display this level of internal energy.”

“This time, while facing the Paradise Enchantress, I absorbed that temptress’s internal energy.”

Of course, there had been several other fortuitous encounters besides that, but I did not explain each one.

“Ah, truly, the heavens are helping you.”

“Then the two of you should help me a little too.”

At that, the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon and the Extreme Evil Young Demon once again shot forward.

To think they disliked each other, yet were able to coordinate like that with the sole intention of teasing me. Perhaps the two of them did not actually dislike each other that much.

As I ran after them, I shouted.

“Where do you think you’re running off to, when you’re both slower than me?”

* * *

We ran and ran like that until we arrived at the entrance to Villains’ Valley.

In the distance, I could see the One-Flower Sword Venerable and the Drunken Demon already there waiting for us. I had only ever seen them drunk and swimming about, or tending flowers in a garden, so seeing them outside felt different.

The Drunken Demon, arms crossed as he looked up at the sky, somehow seemed both lonely and handsome. The Sword Venerable, standing there in clean white robes with a sword at her waist, looked proud and elegant. Both of them felt extraordinary.

“Hyungnim!”

When I called him hyungnim even in the presence of the Demon Venerables, the Drunken Demon’s expression brightened radiantly.

“My dear younger brother!”

I focused on my relationship with the Drunken Demon without being conscious of any other ties.

“Hyungnim, thank you for coming.”

To feel awkward or mind others because of my relationships with the other Demon Venerables would be disrespectful to the Drunken Demon—and to the other Demon Venerables as well.

I am someone who calls the Drunken Demon brother. I believe that only when I clearly show what kind of person I am can I properly form other relationships as well.

“Unless it is something extraordinary, my closed-door training is never disturbed, but Yeobin brought me the news. She said my younger brother wanted my help. Just how did you make Yeobin take your side?”

All I did was look after your health, hyungnim. So Yeobin is the one who is truly on your side.

I could not answer like that, so I smiled and replied.

“Once this matter is over, I’ll buy you a drink.”

I then immediately greeted the One-Flower Sword Venerable politely as well.

“Seeing you outside, your beauty shines all the more.”

“I feel this every time, but your gilding is the most pleasing to hear. I heard you fought the villains of Villains’ Valley this time. Are you injured anywhere?”

“No. The Blade Demon appeared at the decisive moment.”

The One-Flower Sword Venerable looked at the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon and said,

“He may have been waiting for it. The decisive moment, that is.”

At those words, the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon looked dumbfounded and said,

“That’s right. I hid and waited. I wondered, when will the decisive moment come? I should appear only when things become a bit more dangerous.”

“Still, I’m glad you arrived in time. Well done.”

For some reason, the One-Flower Sword Venerable concluded the conversation with kind words. The Blood-Heaven Blade Demon sent me a look as if to say, What’s suddenly gotten into that woman? But how would I know what was in her heart?

Perhaps, on the way here together, the Drunken Demon had said good things about the Blood-Heaven Blade Demon? If so, today might be the starting point of their reconciliation.

The One-Flower Sword Venerable asked me again.

“So? The one behind this hid himself here?”

“Yes. I confirmed it once more through Tongcheon Pavilion. He entered Villains’ Valley.”

“This place is rather troublesome.”

“Fortunately, the Young Demon knows Villains’ Valley well.”

“Is that so?”

The One-Flower Sword Venerable’s gaze turned toward the Extreme Evil Young Demon. The bloodstains on his mask spoke of how urgent the previous situation had been.

The Extreme Evil Young Demon bowed his head lightly, and the One-Flower Sword Venerable exchanged greetings with him as well. The Sword Venerable treated the Drunken Demon like a friend, but with the Extreme Evil Young Demon, they maintained mutual courtesy.

They seemed like they were as indifferent to each other as chickens and dogs, but in truth, the reason I had formed a connection with the Extreme Evil Young Demon was because of the One-Flower Sword Venerable. When Cheongseon was being established as the Soul-Capturing Demon Venerable, she had told me that the Extreme Evil Young Demon had cast an approving vote. That was why I had gone to find him.

“Our target is Yang Cheogi. The villains here have committed crimes that deserve death, but there is no need to deliberately carry out an unnecessary massacre. It should be enough to eliminate only those who stand in our way.”

At my words, everyone nodded with expressions of understanding.

“There is one more thing I must tell you, concerning Yang Cheogi. Though the goal is to capture him alive, his martial arts are so strong that if capturing him proves difficult, you may kill him. Capture if possible, but this absolutely does not mean you must capture him alive at the cost of taking risks. The safety of everyone here comes first, no matter what.”

At that, the Drunken Demon said to the One-Flower Sword Venerable,

“Just who among us is my younger brother so worried about?”

“His drunken hyungnim, I suppose?”

“Ah, is it me?”

Even though they were Demon Venerables, charging into Villains’ Valley was something that could be burdensome and unpleasant. Yet they did not show the slightest sign of it. They did not even make a joke of claiming credit. I believe that was because of their feelings for me. It was a gratitude I must not forget.

“Thank you for coming like this for my sake. To be able to carry out a mission with four Demon Venerables is truly an immense honor. I will never forget today. If there were a painter here, I would have them paint us as we are today… Ah, where are you going? Listen to the end! I’m coming too!”

I followed after the Demon Venerables, who had gone ahead first, and entered Villains’ Valley.

After walking a little way inside, we found a warning written in red letters.

—The good shall surely die.

At that, the Drunken Demon looked around at us and said,

“Fortunately, there’s no one among us who will die.”

At those words, everyone laughed together.

“I’m in danger.”

When I protested at the injustice, the Extreme Evil Young Demon said,

“By that phrase, the safest person here is the Second Young Master.”

The gazes directed at me all seemed to agree with those words. Only the Drunken Demon took my side.

“I believe in my younger brother’s innocence. My kindhearted younger brother.”

“That makes me sound even more like a villain, doesn’t it?”

The Blood-Heaven Blade Demon, who had been listening, could not hold back and threw in a remark.

“I’m sick to death of hearing that damned ‘younger brother, younger brother.’”

Worried that he might pointlessly start a war of nerves with the Drunken Demon, I quickly took up his words.

“Exactly. How is a man without any sworn brothers supposed to live with the sorrow of it?”

At that, the Drunken Demon laughed and took a sip of liquor. I had been watching him since the day we first met, and it was certain that he drank less than before.

I sent a voice transmission to the Drunken Demon.

—You’ve cut down on drinking a lot. Impressive, brother.

—Thanks for noticing.

We could hardly have had this sort of conversation in front of the other Demon Supremes.

How long had we walked like that?

We came across a man with a basket of medicinal herbs on his back. He was just about to bow to us and pass by when—

Whoosh! Thud!

His forehead was pierced by the Blood Ang Finger unleashed by the Extreme Evil Demon, and he toppled over on the spot.

“He’s a scout guarding the entrance. If anyone comes in, his role is to take a shortcut and report it. Besides him…”

Swish! Shaaaak!

Before he could even say that others were hiding up in the trees and behind the rocks, the One Blossom Sword Sovereign sent out sword qi, and the Blood Heaven Blade Demon sent out blade qi.

The man hiding in the tree fell dead, and the rock was split in two, the man behind it meeting the same fate. Moving with Demon Supremes meant words were unnecessary. One gesture was enough.

“It’s been a very long time since I came back, but this place hasn’t changed at all. Back then, too, three of them guarded this spot.”

At the Extreme Evil Demon’s words, I smiled and replied.

“Isn’t the Cult the same? It doesn’t seem as if much has changed from decades ago to now.”

Then the Drunken Demon took a sip of liquor and said,

“That’s why our little brother is trying to establish a new demonic path, isn’t it?”

Instead of answering, I smiled as I looked at the Demon Supremes. I was growing closer to them by the day, but I still did not know just how much they would understand of the demonic path I pursued.

When we went a little farther in, several thatched huts came into view, with rice paddies and fields in front of them. They grew fruit trees and raised cows and pigs as well. It was truly no different from the scenery of any ordinary village.

But beside the fields were terrifying traps, and the flower beds blooming with splendid flowers were teeming with venomous insects.

A swarm of poisonous bees flew at us from somewhere, but from the start, it was impossible for bees to sting Demon Supremes. With a single wave of the hand, they were swept away all at once.

If we had not had someone who knew this place as well as the Extreme Evil Demon did, the road here would have been far more perilous. There were paths where it seemed there could be none, and traps where the way seemed safe.

The Extreme Evil Demon guided us only along shortcuts that avoided the traps.

At last, a village appeared in the distance. It was the first village we had seen since entering the Valley of Villains.

“From here to the tree at the village entrance over there, there are quite a few dangerous traps scattered about. Let’s just leap over them.”

The four Demon Supremes and I launched ourselves into the air at once.

We crossed in a single flight a distance no ordinary master could ever traverse. It was graceful and splendid, a supreme level of lightness skill that no one else could imitate.

Tap! Tap! Tap! Tap! Tap!

We landed in a line at the same time.

The moment we touched the ground, sword qi, blade qi, finger winds, and palm force flew out in every direction. The enemies lying in ambush around us fell one after another without even getting the chance to attack. Though we had not decided our targets in advance, not a single attack overlapped. These were the Demon Supremes of the Cult.

“Now, let’s go in.”

To my left stood the Blood Heaven Blade Demon, and to my right the One Blossom Sword Sovereign. At the far ends on either side were the Extreme Evil Demon and the Drunken Demon.

With the strongest wings in the world spread beside me, I walked into the village of villains.

Chapter 151: When We're Together.
---------------------------------
The village was ordinary. No, it looked ordinary.

There were passersby and merchants, and even children running about.

At a glance, no one would ever think this place was the “village of Evil Valley.”

However, though it seemed like an ordinary village at first glance, the gazes, wariness, and atmosphere of those coming and going were anything but ordinary.

We sensed furtive glances passing between them, but pretended not to notice as we walked along the road.

“Not everyone here follows the Lord of Evil Valley. Rather, there are many who constantly covet his position. You can think of it as similar to the Green Forest.”

That was why we did not rush in using lightness skill.

We made sure our movement would not be taken as an intrusion or an attack. If it were judged to be an attack, every villain in Evil Valley would step forward. Whether they liked it or not, they would try to defend their home.

But we were merely walking as unfamiliar visitors. That difference was enormous, and it was a strategy we could choose because we had the Extreme Evil Little Demon, who understood the nature of Evil Valley better than anyone.

As we walked along the road, we saw more than ten men and women sitting around in an open space, drinking. Whatever was so pleasant and enjoyable, they were laughing and chattering noisily.

The very moment we passed them.

They sprang to their feet and tried to throw hidden weapons. But before the hidden weapons could even leave their hands—

Shiiiiik.

Kwakwakwakwakwa!

A step faster than them, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon’s saber qi swept them away. We had already been prepared for their ambush.

Their acting had been fine up to the point of laughing, chatting, and playing, but even after we passed by, not a single one of them had so much as glanced at us. If it had been two or three people, perhaps, but with more than ten sitting there, not one looking at us was unnatural in itself.

“Most of the villains in Evil Valley are people who would sell even their souls for money. The Lord of Evil Valley has probably put a bounty on us in preparation for our arrival.”

At the Extreme Evil Little Demon’s explanation, I said with a smile,

“He’d have to put up at least a million nyang.”

Then the Drunken Demon said,

“Per person, of course?”

We continued walking while joking like that, when ambushers sprang out again from the woods on both sides.

This time, the Sword Venerable lightly soared upward and spun once in the air, unleashing sword qi. Her sword turned with her, scattering sword qi in every direction.

Those who charged were cut down by the sword qi and all collapsed dead, and not a single strand of sword qi missed its mark.

The Sword Venerable descended once more with elegant footwork to the spot where she had been walking.

As if nothing had happened, we continued the conversation from before as we walked.

“The Lord of Evil Valley isn’t the richest man under heaven. How could he possibly put up a million nyang per person?”

“That’s why only people like this are coming out.”

The moment the Drunken Demon spoke, hidden weapons flew in from the thicket ahead.

We all lightly twisted our bodies and avoided them. The hidden weapons passed through the gaps between the five of us. They flew in fiercely, as if they could never be dodged, but everyone moved lightly and avoided them all.

This time, the Drunken Demon moved. His figure flashed, then vanished into the thicket. And he returned to his original spot even faster than when he had gone in. Not a single scream was heard, so we could not tell how he had dealt with the ambushers.

After returning, he drank a cup of wine and said,

“I gave them all a cup, so they drank and went to sleep.”

I had never properly seen the Drunken Demon fight, but just from this, he was not someone whose martial arts could be underestimated.

After walking on again, we arrived at a ferry.

“From here, we have to take a boat and cross the river.”

We boarded a boat procured at the ferry and crossed the river.

“As the youngest, I’ll row.”

Watching me row, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon said,

“When did you learn how to handle a boat? You’re very used to it.”

“Is there anything I can’t do?”

The other three Demon Venerables also stared at me intently.

“Why are you all staring like that? It’s embarrassing. If you keep doing that, I’ll… row even better, you know? I happen to like being the center of attention.”

I joked, but they all looked at me with strange eyes. It was probably because there were too few things I could not do—far too few.

Like that, the boat swiftly cut through the current.

After staring at the river water for a while, the Drunken Demon suddenly said to the Blood Heaven Blade Demon,

“Seeing you make your move against the enemies this time, senior, you are still hale and vigorous.”

When the Drunken Demon suddenly praised him, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon was visibly flustered.

“Well, I don’t drink much.”

Then the One Flower Sword Venerable said,

“At times like this, just say, ‘Thank you.’ Why is it that even with age, your spitefulness doesn’t lessen?”

She was interfering, but her tone was gentle. Normally, he might have become even more prickly, but this time, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon took a step back.

“Thank you.”

He had meekly thanked the Drunken Demon.

“Not at all. I only said what I felt.”

The One Flower Sword Venerable looked at the Blood Heaven Blade Demon with an expression that asked what had gotten into him.

I could feel that the Drunken Demon was making an effort. That effort was creating change.

The Drunken Demon’s gaze met mine. Thank you, brother. You’re doing well.

The attacks continued.

When the boat reached the middle of the river, ambushers burst out from under the water and launched hidden weapons.

This time, I leaped up while holding an oar and struck them down.

I struck one, stepped on him, then struck another; stepped on that one and struck again. It seemed like nothing special, but it was a technique combining the highest level of footwork and lightness skill.

All those who had leaped up were hit by the oar, their skulls bursting as they fell back into the water. Dressed in fish-scale attire, they were the Yellow River Water Ghosts who had once roamed the Yellow River region. They had plundered passing boats and slaughtered passengers, and in the end had been driven all the way to Evil Valley to live.

The very moment I landed back on the boat—

Boom!

With an explosion, the ferryboat we were riding was blown apart.

The Demon Venerables and I all soared upward. The Water Ghosts poked their heads out of the water and fired poison needles from tubes held in their mouths.

Pikpikpikpikpikpikpik!

But not a single Demon Venerable was struck by those poison needles. They moved their bodies in midair and avoided every ambush. The one to act this time was the Extreme Evil Little Demon.

Ping! Piiing! Ping! Ping!

The Blood Calamity Finger was released in succession. Only then did I learn for the first time that the Extreme Evil Little Demon’s finger wind could be fired continuously like that.

Those who had shot the poison needles floated up as corpses like dead fish.

The Demon Venerables and I each landed on pieces of the shattered boat. Though we stood on fragments smaller than a man’s forearm, they did not sink.

Shaaaaaaaa.

The pieces of wood carrying the Demon Venerables cut through the current and advanced.

There were Water Ghosts far behind us, poking their heads out of the water, but they did not dare attack us. Just the technique of crossing the river atop broken pieces of wood by exerting internal energy was enough to make them lose the will to fight.

Like that, we reached the opposite riverbank in an instant.

The ones whose names were known blocked our path about a hundred zhang away from there.

The movement arts displayed by the five martial artists standing in our way were anything but ordinary.

The Blood Heaven Blade Demon recognized them.

“The Five Evils of Chongqing!”

They were men who had once committed atrocities with the Chongqing region as their base.

“It’s been so many years that few people recognize us now. Old man, who are you?”

“You’ve forgotten me.”

“Do you know me?”

The Blood Heaven Blade Demon merely smiled faintly.

“Seeing as you’re blocking our way, when one grows old, judgment becomes as clouded as memory.”

The First Evil’s expression stiffened.

He had stepped forward to kill, yet some inexplicable unease pricked at him. He was sure he had seen this old man somewhere, but he could not remember.

“Kill them!”

It was an order the First Evil gave to his subordinates, but in the end, it became an order given to the Demon Venerables.

No sooner had his words ended than each of us faced one opponent.

The Extreme Evil Little Demon released the Blood Calamity Finger. Unable to dodge the Blood Calamity Finger fired at close range, the Fourth Evil fell with his forehead pierced through. The One Flower Sword Venerable’s sword technique severed the Second Evil’s neck, and my Azure Heaven Form split open the Fifth Evil’s chest in the blink of an eye. The Third Evil’s head was shattered by the Drunken Demon’s Blood Tears, and he collapsed.

The only one left was the First Evil. The moment they died, he remembered.

“Ah! You… Why are you here?”

His voice trembled violently. There had once been a time when the Blood Heaven Blade Demon had shaken the jianghu. Back then, the First Evil had not even been able to meet his eyes properly, and now, after so many years, they had met again here.

The First Evil hurriedly tried to flee, but the Blood Heaven Blade Demon’s great saber cut his body in half.

While fighting together, I was realizing one thing. Though they seemed to fight indifferently, the Demon Venerables were conscious of one another. They used each move carefully, and while pretending not to look, they attentively watched what techniques the others used. In a sense, the opponents they were paying attention to were not the villains of Evil Valley, but one another. And what they watched most carefully was, naturally, my movements and martial arts.

Even so, I did not bother hiding my skill. I did not reveal everything, but neither did I deliberately try to diminish my abilities. Because I was someone who would become their leader. Because I had to make them trust and follow me.

This time, those who used poisonous smoke attacked.

Several men who had been hiding revealed themselves and sprayed poisonous smoke at us.

The Blood Heaven Blade Demon and the One Flower Sword Venerable stepped forward at the same time, and when they swung their sleeves, the incoming poisonous smoke flew back toward those who had released it.

Then they collapsed in agony, blood gushing from every hole in their bodies.

For the first time since entering this place, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon and the One Flower Sword Venerable coordinated to face the enemy. They looked at each other. The gazes they directed at one another were growing softer and softer.

“Once we pass that field, the Lord of Evil Valley’s residence will appear.”

With about a hundred zhang left until the Lord of Evil Valley’s residence, villains holding spears poured out all at once from one side.

The huge man at the front was holding a spear as large as a pillar.

He was the Giant Strength Ghost Spear, who had once made a name for himself in the martial world with a single spear. A master of the unorthodox path, he had attained mastery in spear arts, but after attacking a branch of the Martial Alliance, he had been branded a public enemy of the martial world and disappeared. Now he had shown himself here in Evil Valley.

Dozens of villains also appeared from the opposite side. Wearing black martial robes and masks that revealed only their eyes, they were assassins. The one leading them was Yin Yue. He had once been famed as an assassin of the highest skill, and here he was leading an organization of assassins.

Those who appeared from another direction wore only undergarments on their lower bodies. Standing there with vacant eyes, they were intoxicated by drugs.

But if one let one’s guard down because of their appearance, one would have one’s entire body torn apart and die. They were far stronger in martial arts than they appeared, and they were men who felt no pain even when stabbed by blades and swords. When such people made up their minds and charged like madmen, there were not many who could withstand their momentum.

Not only them, but this time a group made up solely of women also appeared, as did men dressed as hunters, and even a band of beggars.

Those who appeared were not people receiving the Lord of Evil Valley’s orders, but rather those who each possessed their own forces and lived here. They fought among themselves, trying to seize supremacy over Evil Valley.

It was also because of these people that, when the Lord of Evil Valley’s hands and feet died, he had judged his position to be in danger.

The killing intent and momentum directed at us were no ordinary thing, but the Demon Venerables were not shaken in the slightest.

Wearing his bloodstained mask, the Extreme Evil Little Demon gazed at them haughtily with his arms crossed. That composure was overwhelming the enemy.

The other Demon Venerables were the same. Merely by standing there proudly, they made hundreds of villains unable to dare charge.

The Blood Heaven Blade Demon stepped forward and shouted in a thunderous voice,

“If you’re going to come at us, all of you come at once.”

Guuuuuuung!

Saber aura gathered on the Heaven-Extinguishing Great Saber hanging at his side.

His aura was red as blood. It was my first time seeing his saber aura, and perhaps because it was blood-red, it was truly intense and impressive.

Starting with him, the Demon Venerables each released their own presence. Sword aura also gathered on the One Flower Sword Venerable’s White Flower Sword. Her sword aura was pure white. It was a color that suited her far too well.

As the momentum of the five of us spread in every direction, the villains backed away further, as if pushed by an invisible force.

If I had come alone, or if I had come with only the Extreme Evil Little Demon, we would have had to fight all of them.

But since I had come with the four Demon Venerables, no one dared rush at us.

Hundreds had gathered, but they did not dare attack and only watched from afar. When we were together, there was nothing that could obstruct us.

In the end, they could not attack. Our momentum was one thing, but upon realizing that the place we were heading was the Lord of Evil Valley’s residence, they did not go out of their way to fight. Their greed had now turned toward something greater.

We began walking again. At the end of that road stood the manor where the Lord of Evil Valley lived.

On the signboard above the main gate was written: Mutual Aid in Evil. It meant that even villains aided one another in order to achieve evil.

“He must have received reports that we were coming, so he’ll be waiting with his own preparations.”

At my words, the Extreme Evil Little Demon smashed the signboard with the Demonic Extreme Berserk Palm. The entire place where the signboard had been attached was blown away and disappeared without a trace.

At the same time, the other Demon Venerables released palm force simultaneously. The main gate and the wall in front crumbled into powder.

“If I had come alone, perhaps it would be another matter, but with four of us here together…”

The Extreme Evil Little Demon walked ahead and added,

“If mere preparation were enough to deal with us, we would have to give up our seats as Demon Venerables, wouldn’t we?”

Chapter 152: It's All Your Fault.
---------------------------------
“What you said was true.”

Those were the first words the Valley Master of Villains’ Valley spoke to Yang Cheogi as he entered the main hall.

The Valley Master had sent men out to gather information about what had happened at the time, and had learned that, on that day, a young man and a masked figure had met at the Yellow River Inn. Yang Cheogi’s words had been true.

“Why would I lie to the Valley Master? I told you the truth.”

“Then that really means Geom Mugeuk’s martial arts were enough to contend with the Goe-ma.”

“They were.”

“Even if he is the Heavenly Demon’s own blood, it is hard to believe.”

“It was the same for me. I truly never imagined Geom Mugeuk would be such an expert.”

As if recalling what had happened that day, Yang Cheogi’s expression hardened. He did not seem to be lying, but the Valley Master still suspected him.

There was certainly the possibility that he had helped Geom Mugeuk and killed all of the Valley Master’s subordinates. No, that was more plausible than the fact that Geom Mugeuk had killed the Goe-ma.

What if it had been a plot by the Demon Cult to seize Villains’ Valley?

What if they had used Yang Cheogi to cut off all his hands and feet? What if even the Cheonmyeong Society had been created by the Demon Cult?

Having lost so many men as strong as himself in one place, it was only natural that he would harbor such suspicions.

Of course, there were parts of that theory that did not quite make sense.

‘The Demon Cult has never shown any interest in Villains’ Valley until now, so why are they suddenly targeting this valley?’

Villains’ Valley was, in the end, a headache for the Murim Alliance. Therefore, the Demon Cult had no reason to attack it. Moreover, if the Demon Cult directly operated Villains’ Valley, they would face fierce protests and backlash from the Murim Alliance and the Evil Path Alliance. And yet they would deliberately create trouble? When the villains here would not even offer them loyalty. Why on earth?

Lacking trust in Yang Cheogi, the Valley Master imagined every possible hypothesis. In any case, one thing was certain. Merely looking at Yang Cheogi irritated him.

‘If you have some other sinister scheme in mind, you will never leave Villains’ Valley alive.’

It was then. A subordinate entered and hurriedly reported.

“There are intruders. Gwapyo’s gang at the village entrance has been wiped out.”

The Valley Master felt that what was finally bound to come had arrived.

Yang Cheogi, who was beside him, quickly asked,

“How many intruders are there?”

“They say there are five.”

Yang Cheogi tilted his head.

“If it were Geom Mugeuk’s party, there should be three at most.”

“That may be so, but…”

At Yang Cheogi’s reaction, the Valley Master felt inwardly puzzled.

Judging from his reaction now, it did not feel as though they had plotted this together.

At that moment, another subordinate rushed in.

“The Cheon family gang has also fallen to the intruders.”

“Already?”

The Cheon family gang possessed fairly strong martial arts and excelled at coordinated attacks. Yet they had already been defeated?

Soon after, another subordinate ran in.

“The insects have all been killed.”

This time, he was even more shocked. The “insects” he spoke of referred to Yangsu’s group who lived in the forest. Hiding in the woods and firing hidden weapons, they were truly difficult opponents to deal with.

Yang Cheogi and the Valley Master’s gazes met. Yang Cheogi nodded and said,

“It is definitely them.”

Considering whom Geom Mugeuk and the Extreme Evil Young Demon had killed as a pair, what on earth would happen if five of them had come?

Before the shock could even fade, another subordinate came running in, and this time the Valley Master asked first.

“Who fell this time?”

“At the Bridge of Good and Evil, the Yellow River Water Ghosts were defeated.”

“What? The Water Ghosts?”

The Valley Master was startled. One could not say they were stronger than anyone else, but in the water, the Water Ghosts were stronger than anyone.

Yes, they could die. But the problem was that the defenses were being pierced far too quickly. Their current speed was like someone striding forward and plucking flowers growing along the path.

At that moment, the Valley Master saw it. Yang Cheogi’s eyes were trembling. He was afraid.

“If you want to run, run even now.”

If Yang Cheogi was gone, he intended to pin all the blame on him and somehow search for a way to survive.

“What does the Valley Master intend to do?”

“I cannot leave this place anyway. The moment I flee, I will be giving those who covet my seat a pretext to kill me.”

As it was, all of his trustworthy subordinates were already dead.

Yang Cheogi was conflicted. He truly had never imagined that Geom Mugeuk would storm all the way here. Nor had he known that Villains’ Valley would be breached so easily. This was a place where anyone who did not know the way would wander near the entrance for days.

But if he ran from here now, the Valley Master would never accept him again. His feelings toward Yang Cheogi were already at their worst.

‘If I am to rise to the position of Valley Master, I must stop Geom Mugeuk’s party today. Only then will the villains here acknowledge me as the Valley Master.’

And if the Valley Master died in the process, that would be all the better.

While the two of them were in the midst of dreaming different dreams in the same bed, yet another subordinate entered.

“The Five Evils of Chongqing are all dead.”

Now the Valley Master was not even surprised. If all this was not a prank his subordinates had devised to startle him, then it was a calamity flying toward him at a terrifying speed.

Hatred toward Yang Cheogi surged up in his heart.

‘This is all because of you.’

If Yang Cheogi had not provoked the Extreme Evil Young Demon in the first place, claiming he would take revenge, none of this would have happened.

‘No matter what it takes, I will kill you.’

The Valley Master knew well that harboring such deep resentment toward someone would ultimately do him no good.

But he simply could not endure Yang Cheogi. Even if he came to regret this decision later, he vowed that he would absolutely kill Yang Cheogi.

The Valley Master said to his subordinate,

“Tell Elder Shi to exhaust their internal energy as much as possible.”

“Yes!”

The subordinate ran out.

“Elder Shi is the last line of defense. If he is broken through, only you and I remain.”

“Let us hope he drains as much of their strength as he can.”

If Elder Shi played his role properly, perhaps a way might open.

* * *

The courtyard was empty.

Looking around, I said,

“This feels rather eerie.”

As expected, my feeling was accurate.

The moment we crossed the courtyard and walked toward the building where the main hall was located.

Ssssss.

Our surroundings changed.

Before we knew it, we were standing in a new space, and hundreds of stone statues stood on all sides. They were statues in the shape of martial artists holding swords, sabers, and spears.

“It’s an illusion art!”

At my shout, the Demon Venerables grew tense. If one did not know how to break it, there was nothing more troublesome than this. This was also why the Murim Alliance had feared the Soul-Capturing Demon Venerable the most.

“Everyone, be careful.”

At the Blood Heaven Blade Demon’s warning, we stood in a circle with our backs against one another.

The stone statues began to move. Since they were stone statues, one would expect them to be extremely sluggish, but they were faster than expected. Things that ought to have been slow came charging in quickly, making them feel utterly grotesque and terrifying.

Boom!

The battle began with the Extreme Evil Young Demon’s Demonic Extreme Rampage Palm smashing a stone statue that had rushed toward us.

Stone statues were sliced apart by the One Flower Sword Venerable’s sword energy. To conserve internal energy, she could not strike stone blocks directly with her sword. Since it was a famed sword, she could handle a few statues that way, but if she faced this many, the sword would be damaged. So the One Flower Sword Venerable had no choice but to use sword energy.

The Blood Heaven Blade Demon was in a similar situation. Since he used a great saber, it was better than a sword, but even so, he could not batter stone statues apart with the precious Heaven-Destroying Great Saber. In the end, he also stirred up saber energy and saber wind to shatter the statues.

The Extreme Evil Young Demon was the same. With the Blood Devouring Finger, the stone statues continued moving even with holes pierced through them, so he had to use the Demonic Extreme Rampage Palm, which consumed more internal energy, to smash them apart.

The Drunken Demon also could not strike them with Blood Tears, so he used palm techniques to face them.

They were opponents that consumed an enormous amount of internal energy, and they surged in endlessly.

Since we could not simply waste our energy like this, I dodged the stone statues’ attacks while examining my surroundings. With the Blood-Eye Essence implanted in my eyes and the Divine Eye Art bestowed upon me, I would surely be able to see the method of breaking it.

But nowhere in this space could I see the bluish light that marked the method of breaking the technique.

‘It’s there. It definitely exists.’

Because an illusion art without a method to break it absolutely did not exist.

Using Shadow Step and Flash Step, I swiftly wove between the stone statues and began searching for the method to break it.

Then, at some point while wandering among the statues.

‘I found it!’

On the back of a stone statue farther behind, a bluish light was glowing.

It had been among the hundreds of attacking stone statues, so this was truly an illusion art that had hidden its method of breaking extremely well.

Riiiiiip!

Without hesitation, I tore through the bluish light with the Black Demon Sword and split it in half.

Beyond that light, an old man was staring in astonishment.

Puk!

The moment my sword drove into the old man’s heart, the illusion art he had cast shattered.

Freed from the illusion, we were standing in the courtyard we had entered earlier. Seeing the old man impaled by my sword collapse, the Demon Venerables realized that I had found the method to break the illusion.

The Drunken Demon made a fuss, saying, “Little Brother, you’re the best,” and the One Flower Sword Venerable looked greatly surprised.

On the other hand, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon, knowing that I had killed the Soul-Capturing Demon Venerable, was not particularly surprised.

Lastly, the Extreme Evil Young Demon looked at me, smiled meaningfully, and said,

“Second Young Master has reached the realm of being invulnerable to all four arts.”

Since the other Demon Venerables were present, he did not mention the Soul-Capturing Demon Venerable, but if it had been just the two of us, he would have said this: Shameless Second Young Master, will you still claim you did not kill the Soul-Capturing Demon Venerable?

I strode toward the building.

“Now then, let us go in.”

Smashing the door of the main hall, I entered with the Demon Venerables.

* * *

Boooom!

Seeing those who entered by smashing the door of the main hall, the Valley Master thought the Heavenly Demon himself had invaded.

Otherwise, how could Elder Shi’s illusion art have been broken through so quickly? Even he himself, if caught in Elder Shi’s illusion art, would have to endure until Elder Shi’s internal energy ran dry before escaping.

But the one who had invaded was not the Heavenly Demon. As if proving Yang Cheogi’s words true, the young man Geom Mugeuk walked in at the front.

Yang Cheogi made no answer.

Geom Mugeuk’s gaze turned to the Valley Master.

“That is right. I am the Valley Master.”

The Valley Master tried hard to appear calm, but the pressure of the god of death walking toward him one step at a time was burning him up inside.

The Valley Master’s gaze shifted to the four Demon Venerables standing behind Geom Mugeuk.

“Honored figures of the Divine Cult have come. Welcome.”

As if treating invited guests, the Valley Master brazenly cupped his fists and greeted them.

“You are one who will become the supreme ruler of murim in the future. Please do not behave the same way as the pathetic scum of this valley.”

The Valley Master did everything he could to curry favor with Geom Mugeuk.

With Geom Mugeuk and the Demon Venerables standing in a line right before his eyes, he could not even summon the will to fight. If the dead Goe-ma, the Iron Chain Master, the Three Lords of the Bloody Road, the Blood Wolf Saber, the Paradise Enchantress, and the Yama Divine Lord were all here, then perhaps. But for him and Yang Cheogi alone to face the five before them was impossible.

“Why did you do it?”

“Why did you do it?”

Yang Cheogi looked at him with an expression of disbelief.

“What are you trying to pull?”

“You caused this, so you explain it.”

The Valley Master’s struggle to survive began first with distancing himself from Yang Cheogi.

When Geom Mugeuk’s party had entered, Yang Cheogi’s reaction had clearly shown that he was not one of them. In that case, there was only one choice for the Valley Master. He had to abandon Yang Cheogi. They had come to kill Yang Cheogi.

Yang Cheogi snorted.

“I will spare you. I know full well that this entire affair was the doing of Yang Cheogi over there. If the Valley Master will only cooperate in capturing the leader of the Heavenly Mandate Society, no harm will come to you.”

If cooperation meant his life would be spared, what was there to think about?

The moment the Valley Master turned against him, he knew that he would never leave this place alive.

Yang Cheogi drew up his internal energy for the final secret technique he had never once used—no, had never been able to use.

When the Extreme Evil Little Demon saw a red aura gathering in his eyes, he issued a warning.
