“That’s right. Since when did we ever fight because we had an abundance of internal energy?”

Chapter 549: He Would Have Done the Same
----------------------------------------
“Where are you now?”

When Bi Sa-in returned empty-handed from investigating the outskirts, not only Geom Mu-geuk and the Geugak Soma, but even the Fighting King and the woman inside the palanquin had vanished. Seeing that the palanquin itself remained, he thought they must be fighting within the dark sorcery.

The fact that they had not emerged despite so much time passing meant a difficult battle was still ongoing.

Moreover, Jin Ha-gun and the Myeolma Unit, who had fallen into the formation, had yet to come out. Jin Ha-ryeong and the Cheonhwa Tower Master were nowhere to be seen either.

“We have to uncover the secret of that palanquin.”

Those who had fought him while connected to that palanquin had truly unleashed internal energy without end. There had to be some secret hidden within it related to internal energy.

Even so, they could not simply destroy the palanquin at random. The aura emanating from it was far from ordinary, and the disappearance of Geom Mu-geuk and the Geugak Soma might very well be because of that palanquin.

“How about expanding the search area a little farther?”

Bi Sa-in shook his head. He did not think that monstrous internal energy could have been sent from far away.

“It’s definitely somewhere nearby.”

Then Bi Sa-in’s gaze turned toward one place.

One place they had not searched.

The place they had been unable to search.

It was where the warriors stood in the darkness, only their eyes revealed.

The only place nearby they had not searched was right there.

As Bi Sa-in stared at them quietly, a strange gleam passed through his eyes.

“Don’t those fellows seem suspicious?”

They were confronting the Faceless Guests, showing only their eyes. Strange eyes with white rims around the pupils.

“I heard that those who cultivate the Dark Heaven Night God Art have eyes like that.”

At Il-rang’s words, Bi Sa-in nodded. He knew that as well.

“That’s not why I said it.”

Il-rang looked at Bi Sa-in with an expression that asked, Then why?

“Aren’t those fellows gathered too tightly in one place?”

Indeed, they were. Even the Faceless Guests confronting them seemed to be scattered here and there at random, but in truth they were naturally spread out in preparation for the enemy’s attack.

By contrast, those men were lurking in the darkness, huddled closely together. Everyone had been so focused on those bizarre eyes that they had missed it, but Bi Sa-in had pointed out precisely that.

“You’re right. If concealed weapons were poured into them, the damage would be great.”

Not only that, something about them felt strange. They subtly pricked at Bi Sa-in’s instincts.

“Let’s take a look behind them.”

Moving stealthily, Bi Sa-in kept enough distance not to be detected and approached their rear.

Both Bi Sa-in and the Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path were shocked.

It was different from how it had appeared from the front. No matter how far back they went, there were still more of them. The eyes gleaming at the front were only a small portion of the whole.

Because of the distance, and because these men did not reveal the slightest trace of their presence, they had not realized from the front that there were this many of them.

Like a fish in the dark depths luring prey with a glowing protrusion, their true body lay elsewhere.

“Could they be troops hidden to strike us if the situation turns urgent?”

When Il-rang whispered the question, Bi Sa-in shook his head.

“If that were the case, they would have hidden them better.”

They were too easy to spot for an ambush, and too tightly clustered to be an attacking formation.

“Normally, when a force of this size moves, there should be people posted on the outer perimeter. But there isn’t a single one.”

Quite literally, they were gathered in one place. They looked like one enormous mass.

As they stared at them in silence, Chil-rang whispered.

“The way their eyes blink is strange.”

Chil-rang had always had a sharp eye and knew the bizarre martial arts of the unorthodox factions well.

“There’s a fixed pattern to their blinking.”

At his words, everyone focused on the blinking of those eyes.

Indeed, once they looked at it as something strange, it was strange.

They closed their eyes, then opened them.

Once closed, they did not open for a long time; once opened, they did not close. The sight was truly bizarre, and there was a definite pattern to it.

Just then, the moon that had been hidden behind clouds briefly revealed itself.

Because the Dark King had entered the Space-Time Transposition Art, moonlight had finally appeared outside.

At that moment, Chil-rang discovered something.

“Look over there.”

There was something cutting through the air. A certain aura, rising like a heat haze, extended from the darkness where the eyes were gathered to the palanquin. Beneath the moonlight, it was a flow of energy visible only if one looked very closely.

“It’s them!”

The secret was not far away.

They were transmitting internal energy to the palanquin. Those with their eyes closed were replenishing their internal energy, and those with their eyes open were transmitting it through some sinister grand art of their own.

Now he knew for certain why they had not come out of the darkness.

Once he learned the secret, Bi Sa-in grew anxious. Right now, Geom Mu-geuk and the Geugak Soma must be in the worst battle possible, facing that endlessly supplied internal energy with their own internal energy emptied.

“Wipe them all out!”

At Bi Sa-in’s command, the Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path drew their swords in unison and prepared to attack.

“We strike with sword qi at the same time.”

After approaching as close as possible, Bi Sa-in launched himself toward them.

Shiiik!

Bi Sa-in’s sword emitted sword qi.

The Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path following behind him also unleashed sword qi all at once.

Because the enemy was clustered together, they intended to sweep them all away with sword qi in a single blow.

Whooooosh!

Black smoke suddenly surged up around them.

Thud! Thud! Thudthudthudthud!

The incoming sword qi was blocked by the pitch-black smoke. Just as it had become protective energy guarding the Fighting King’s body, it was guarding these people as well.

As if declaring that what it received would be returned.

This time, sword qi flew out from within the smoke.

Shwikshwikshwikshwikshwik!

Papapapapak!

The Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path scattered left and right to evade it.

“Close combat!”

Bi Sa-in took the lead and rushed toward them. He instinctively understood that a battle exchanging sword qi from afar would ultimately become a contest of internal energy, and that they would be at a disadvantage.

The black-clad warriors at the front thrust out their swords in unison. They had not been standing clumped together at random. They had formed a formation capable of blocking an attack if someone came at them.

Clang!

The internal energy carried in their swords was tremendous. At the unexpected power, Bi Sa-in nearly lost his grip on his sword.

“Everyone, be careful!”

As he knocked aside the incoming blades, Bi Sa-in could tell. Just as in the earlier fight against the four black-clad men, the internal energy contained in these men’s swords was not that of a single person.

Shwaaak.

The enemies split to the left and right, and the black-clad warriors behind them launched sword qi.

Bi Sa-in threw himself aside and dodged the sword qi. The black-clad men on that side also poured out sword qi.

Bi Sa-in accepted the danger and charged toward them.

Shiiik!

Exploiting their opening, Bi Sa-in drove his sword into the chest of the black-clad man standing before him.

Puk!

The eyes of the one whose heart had been pierced instantly turned pure white, and his body blackened as he collapsed. He was no ordinary human.

Whiririririk!

As he fell, the group of black-clad men began spinning all at once. The fallen corpse was swept away somewhere, and as they revolved, they scattered sword qi.

Bi Sa-in threw himself aside to evade the sword qi.

When he had first given the order to attack, he had thought they could wipe them all out in one go.

But they could not. The enemy was not easy. Above all, the internal energy contained in their attacks was tremendous.

“Fine. If you’re going to use internal energy, use it all over here!”

However, the flow of internal energy running through the darkness toward the palanquin still continued.

Papapapak!

While running to avoid the sword qi, he looked at the Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path. They too were unable to break through easily.

“Back!”

At Bi Sa-in’s command, the Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path retreated for a moment.

Bi Sa-in drew up his internal energy and unleashed the Hegemon Heaven-Shaking Sword Art, the exclusive martial art of the Evil Path Alliance Leader.

First Sword: Hundred Heavens Form.

A wave of energy emitting a pure white radiance swept toward them.

The Hundred Heavens Form pierced through the smoke protecting them and swept straight over them.

But at the very moment the energy crashed down, the single mass split in half in an instant.

Pubeobeobeobeok!

Three or four black-clad men were caught in the energy and sent flying, but as if nothing had happened, they merged together again.

From within the darkness, all of their eyes stared at Bi Sa-in at once.

They looked together, then blinked at the same time.

The sight was truly grotesque.

Their movements were not like a sword formation or a combined attack art.

Bi Sa-in could feel it. They were connected like a single organism.

This time, they attacked first.

Like the legs of an octopus, more than ten branches shot out from the large mass and thrust their swords all at once.

Clangclangclangclangclang!

Caught in the sudden attack, Sipil-rang, whose shoulder had been injured, was driven into a corner.

The nearby Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path tried to help him, but the black-clad men clung to them viciously.

“Careful!”

Just as Sibi-rang, who was closest to him, was about to throw himself toward him despite his injuries—

Shukshukshukshukshukshukshukshukshukshuk!

Finger winds poured down on the black-clad men like rain.

The black-clad men pressing Sipil-rang all flipped over and collapsed at once.

When Bi Sa-in looked back, he saw the Faceless Guests.

Seeing the warriors of the Evil Path Alliance strike at the eyes in the darkness, the Faceless Guests had stepped in to help.

Bi Sa-in shouted to the Faceless Guests.

“These things are sending internal energy to their leader.”

Those words were enough. It meant that because of them, the Young Cult Master and the Geugak Soma were in danger.

The Faceless Guests exchanged glances, then drew daggers all at once. As they used finger winds as their main martial art, they used daggers in close combat.

The Faceless Guests surged forward like white crests of waves on a night sea.

Once even the Faceless Guests joined the fight, it truly became a scene of carnage.

The Faceless Guests seemed like people with no fear at all.

They fought while swinging their daggers madly, then suddenly fired finger winds at the opponent’s face with their other hand.

It was like watching an even stranger creature hunt a bizarre, enormous lifeform.

Then one Faceless Guest who had gone too deep into the enemy had his connection to his comrades cut off.

The black-clad men surrounding him from all sides attacked him together.

It was an assault that could not be withstood with small daggers and finger winds. He endured by doggedly striking them down, but—

Puk!

In the end, he was stabbed in the waist and sank to his knees. A black-clad man swung his sword down toward his face.

Puuk!

Blood splattered across the Faceless Guest’s mask.

A sword had emerged from the chest of the black-clad man who had been about to kill him.

When the black-clad man collapsed, Bi Sa-in stood behind him. He had broken in from the other side and saved him.

“To think the day would come when I save a Faceless Guest!”

That was Bi Sa-in’s honest feeling.

Then, from another side, the Faceless Guests broke through and entered.

Bi Sa-in disappeared back the way he had come, and the Faceless Guests silently watched his back.

As the battle continued, the tightly clustered black-clad men began to split apart. No matter that they had cultivated the Dark Heaven Night God Art, their opponents were Bi Sa-in and the Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path, and added to them were the Faceless Guests, who did not fear death.

Bi Sa-in saw it. The internal energy transmitted through the air had been severed.

“The internal energy has been cut off! Push harder!”

The black-clad men tried to send internal energy no matter what.

One group tried to send the internal energy while another tried to protect them, and Bi Sa-in and the Thirteen Wolves of the Evil Path desperately tried to stop it.

“That internal energy will become the internal energy that kills Geom Mu-geuk!”

Swaaaaaak!

Bi Sa-in charged like a bull and broke through them. Sword qi flew in at him, but he blocked it with protective energy.

After rolling across the ground, Bi Sa-in sprang back to his feet and rushed toward another group. When the one sending internal energy died, the energy flying through the air failed to reach the palanquin and vanished.

“Stop them over there!”

It was truly a desperate struggle between those trying to send and those trying to stop.

In the end, perhaps deciding this could not go on, the black-clad men made their final decision.

They gathered toward a single focal point, and for a moment an unpleasant silence flowed. The white rims in the black-clad men’s eyes began spinning all at once.

Whiiiiiing!

Black smoke began whirling around them like a tornado. A mournful sound like the wailing of ghosts rang out, and an evil aura spewed in every direction.

“Danger! Everyone, back!”

Bi Sa-in had thought it would be fine as long as they did not send internal energy to the palanquin.

Whiiiii.

The whirlwind vanished, and an astonishing sight unfolded.

All of the black-clad men had fallen. Their eyes had turned white, and their bodies had turned pitch-black.

The aura flowing out from those corpses began moving toward the palanquin.

It was not the ordinary internal energy from before. It was a bizarre and powerful energy paid for with death, and black smoke whirled around it as it enveloped the power.

“No!”

Bisain swung his sword at the energy. The blade merely cleaved through it and passed on; that was all. Just as one could not kill air, he could not stop that energy.

He sent sword qi flying, but that too was useless. Rather, the black smoke struck by the sword qi began to move even more vigorously.

As though following an invisible trajectory, it drifted slowly toward the palanquin. The sight was truly astonishing and bizarre.

Bisain launched himself forward and stood before the palanquin. He could feel it. If this power was transmitted, Geom Mugeuk would die.

“I’ll have to block it with internal force.”

That energy, in the end, was also a power that would become internal energy; he thought only internal energy could stop it.

Illang rushed over and tried to stop him.

“You mustn’t. You can’t overcome such a powerful force, and even if you do, that black energy will inflict grave internal injuries on you! No—you may die.”

“If this power is transmitted, the Young Cult Leader will die.”

“Then would it not be better to destroy the palanquin?”

As if Bisain had not thought of that.

“What if the Young Cult Leader and the Wicked Little Demon are inside?”

If that was the case, it would mean killing his friend with his own hands.

“We will leave the fight inside to the Young Cult Leader. We must stop that energy.”

Whiiiiiiing.

In the meantime, the energy had drawn close.

“Then I will block it.”

Illang stood in front, and behind him the Sado Thirteen Wolves lined up one after another.

Of course, Bisain was not someone who would stand behind them.

Bisain stepped in front of Illang.

“Young Alliance Leader!”

“Illang, if the Young Cult Leader and the Demon Venerable die, our lives cannot be guaranteed either.”

It was true. If those who had killed the two of them appeared and began sweeping through this place, they would not be able to stop them.

And then came an even more decisive sentence.

“That friend would have done the same.”

Illang knew better than anyone how Bisain regarded Geom Mugeuk. And so he also knew he could not stop him.

Bisain drew up his protective qi aura and turned around.

There was no time to argue. The energy was already right before them.

Illang placed his palm against Bisain’s back. Behind Illang, Irang did the same; behind Irang, Samrang. In that way, all of the Sado Thirteen Wolves placed their palms against the backs of the men before them. On their faces appeared the resolve to die together if they died, and live together if they lived.

Whiiiiiiiiii!

It was like a black shooting star flying toward them.

Bisain raised his internal energy to the limit and extended his hand.

Only now did he realize that he could stake his life for Geom Mugeuk without the slightest hesitation. For someone who made him dance and teased him every time they met.

‘I will cut off that internal energy no matter what, so you must win and come out!’

At the very instant the thing that had flown toward them was about to touch Bisain’s palm—

An astonishing scene unfolded before his eyes.

Saaaaaaa.

With an unknowable sound, the oncoming energy seemed to slow for a moment.

Then the black smoke wrapped around the energy turned transparent and began to shine like ice.

He thought it had changed into white smoke, but it had not.

Ssaaaaaaa!

A cold chill that seemed to freeze the lungs swept over them.

Then, as if time itself had stopped, the movement of the smoke coiling around the energy began to halt as well.

Crack, craaack!

Everything that had been flying toward them froze in midair.

Chapter 550: I Am Coming Now.
-----------------------------
The swirling black smoke froze white, and in that moment, it was as beautiful as a snowflake.

The ice crystals gleamed in the darkness, feeling like a work of art crafted by a master artisan who had poured his very soul into it.

Beyond them, the figure of a woman could be seen.

On the palm of the woman clad in pristine white robes, crystals of snow bloomed like a heat shimmer. It was clear that she had executed a single move moments before.

Bisain and the woman locked eyes.

Two clear, cold eyes shone in the darkness upon her snow-white skin.

‘How can a person give off such a pure feeling?’

It was the first time he had ever felt this from anyone.

The woman was none other than Hanseol, the Young Palace Mistress of the North Sea Ice Palace.

Behind her, a middle-aged man and woman likewise clad in white stood as if guarding her; they were the Hanbing Twin Swords, peerless experts of the North Sea.

Sent by the Ice Palace Lord out of worry for her daughter’s first journey to the Central Plains, there was no need to even speak of their skill.

Bisain walked over to her and introduced himself first.

“I am Bisain, Young Lord of the Demonic Alliance.”

Hanseol likewise introduced herself.

“I am Hanseol, Young Palace Mistress of the North Sea Ice Palace.”

Upon learning her identity, Bisain was inwardly surprised. He had heard from Geommugeuk that someone new would be coming to this gathering, but he had never imagined it would be the Young Palace Mistress of the North Sea Ice Palace.

Just as it had been for Bisain, Hanseol’s first impression of him was intense. She had never met anyone with such a frightening and powerful presence.

After gazing at her for a moment, Bisain’s eyes shifted to the frozen dark energy floating in the air.

Hanseol conveyed with an elegant yet respectful hand gesture that he should handle it himself, and Bisain returned a respectful cupped-fist salute in gratitude.

Bisain drew his sword and raised the true qi of the Overlord Heaven-Piercing Sword Art. A powerful killing intent surged around his blade.

Shwiiiiik!

Boom!

The clustered energies, still frozen, shattered and scattered. As the central core broke, the energies began to vanish entirely.

Once they had completely dissipated, only beautiful shards of ice glittered in every direction.

Bisain turned to look at the Thirteen Demon Wolves. He was grateful to them for having staked their lives alongside him in the final moment. Having read the sentiment in Bisain’s eyes, the Thirteen Demon Wolves answered with gazes full of unwavering loyalty.

In the past, Bisain would not have looked back at them in moments like these. He had taken it for granted. No, from the very beginning, he had never even entertained the thought that he should connect with them.

But now, Bisain looked back. He had become someone who looked back, someone who faced others squarely.

Bisain’s gaze turned once more toward Hanseol.

“I am grateful. Thanks to you, my life was saved.”

A peculiar glint briefly flickered across Hanseol’s eyes at those words. Given the momentum Bisain and the Thirteen Demon Wolves had shown while blocking the energy earlier, one could not say how things might have turned out.

He could have simply thanked her for her aid; yet he had gone so far as to say she had saved his life. One would think the Young Lord of the Demonic Alliance would detest owing a life debt.

“You needn’t thank me. I merely froze those ominous things.”

The Hanbing Twin Swords standing behind her exchanged glances.

The Ice Palace Lord’s greatest worry had been whether her daughter would get along with others out in the Central Plains, yet here she was, handling herself calmly and well. This must be what they mean when they say a child is different outside the home than before their parents.

“I came at the invitation of the Young Cult Leader of the Heavenly Demon Cult. He called it a festival.”

She looked around. Destruction and rubble. Corpses piled high. And ghost-masked onlookers staring at her on top of it all.

Bisain spoke to her.

“If you think of the one who invited you, it is not strange at all.”

Hanseol agreed with those words. For it was indeed Geommugeuk who had turned the North Sea Ice Palace upside down before leaving. And even the relationship between her and her mother.

“Where is the Young Cult Leader now?”

Bisain looked at her for a moment, then answered in a voice full of conviction.

“He is coming now.”

* * *

A desperate battle was unfolding.

They were fighting an opponent overflowing with internal energy while carefully conserving and rationing their own.

Swhaaaak.

Tu Wang’s fist flew toward Geugak Soma’s face.

Thwack!

The one who struck Tu Wang’s wrist and changed its path was Geommugeuk.

Stab! Stab!

Geugak Soma’s daggers embedded themselves consecutively into Tu Wang’s abdomen. It was an attack that completely disregarded defense; if he had not believed that Geommugeuk could cover him, he would not have dared to attempt it.

The two were literally tearing through the limits of concentration and entering a new realm of focus. They had fought many battles together, but never before had they fought with such unified breath as they did today.

Hwaang!

Tu Wang’s frenzied fist halted in midair, his abdomen pierced.

Sgaak!

Geommugeuk’s sword, flying in to sever Tu Wang’s arm, grazed the iron chain attached to the fist.

As Tu Wang’s frenzied punches flew wild in succession, the two escaped from within his range.

Tu Wang looked down at his own abdomen.

It was an attack that should have been fatal, yet black smoke covered the wound.

“Damn it!”

If not for Am Wang, this too would have been a critical injury.

Tu Wang was enraged. Geommugeuk and Geugak Soma were almost struck yet evaded each time. His pride was wounded that he could not kill those who fought while conserving their internal energy so frugally.

Then Am Wang’s calm voice flowed out.

“Calm yourself. Time is on our side.”

Geommugeuk spoke in response to her words.

“Is it truly on your side?”

At her questioning gaze, Geommugeuk said:

“I believe time is on our side. Aren’t you curious about what is happening outside?”

“Our Young Cult Leader is harboring vain hope.”

Geommugeuk was inwardly hoping for one thing. When the four black threads connected to the palanquin had snapped, Bisain had not come to help him.

When someone who was certain to come did not arrive, there was surely a reason. He desperately hoped that reason was the very thing he wished for.

“He is a smarter friend than he looks. I am certain time is on our side.”

Am Wang answered with an equally certain gaze.

“Today, within this darkness, no one can save you.”

Tu Wang charged again, kicking up a cloud of dust. His two eyes brimmed with a murderous resolve to kill Geommugeuk no matter what.

Swhaaaaaaaa!

The swirling fist winds turned the sandstorm into a tempest.

Geommugeuk and Geugak Soma rolled across the ground to dodge the oncoming attacks. They did not bother with pride or appearances.

It was a fight of pure life or death, one that did not permit even a single move’s mistake. If one erred, Geugak Soma would die; if one erred, Geommugeuk would die.

That was why this battle granted a new experience to both Geommugeuk and Geugak Soma.

Extreme speed. Extreme power.

They were confronting the terrifying attacks pouring from those fists with the bare minimum of internal energy. If they survived, it would be the worst yet also the greatest battle, one certain to affect their martial realm.

Internal energy was used only when absolutely necessary. For moments exactly like this one.

Papapapapapak!

As the Linked Wind and Cloud Fist was unleashed, dozens of fists flew toward the two of them.

Geommugeuk used the Dark Shadow Step to dodge the sword qi and unleashed a stroke of his own. The target was not Tu Wang.

Poong!

One of the flying sword qi blasts dissipated in midair.

Geugak Soma hurled his body precisely into the space where it had vanished.

Poong! Pung-pung-pung! Pung!

The area where Geugak Soma had stood was smashed and overturned.

When unleashing a large technique, gaps were bound to appear before the next move could link; Geommugeuk and Geugak Soma did not miss that instant.

Geommugeuk charged from the left, and Geugak Soma from the right.

Tu Wang had no choice but to prioritize Geommugeuk, for he never knew when the Guhwa Demonic Art would be used.

Geommugeuk poured out the internal energy he had been conserving to attack him.

Chaeng-chaeng-chaeng-chaeng-chaeng!

Fist and sword clashed in midair, sending sparks flying.

Stab! Stab!

In that gap, Geugak Soma’s daggers stabbed Tu Wang’s abdomen and shoulder in succession. Black energy saved him endlessly, but the two did not give up.

Tu Wang attacked like a madman without caring for his injuries, and in the end, Geommugeuk and Geugak Soma blocked the onslaught with protective qi barriers and bounced backward.

Tu Wang pulled out the dagger embedded deep in his shoulder. It was the dagger Geugak Soma had thrown while leaping back.

Puuaak.

Blood sprayed, but soon black smoke blocked the wound and stopped the bleeding.

“You should know by now that these kinds of attacks are useless, no?”

Geommugeuk stared at him and answered Tu Wang’s mockery.

“That smoke might betray you at some point, mightn’t it?”

Geommugeuk was not speaking to Tu Wang, but to Am Wang, who flickered over Tu Wang’s pupils.

Then Am Wang spoke in a mysterious and calm tone.

“Looking at your condition, it seems there is no reason for betrayal.”

Geugak Soma’s breathing could be heard.

“Haah... haah...”

Rough breaths came from beneath the mask.

Having listened quietly to that breathing, Geommugeuk flicked his finger.

Tak!

Then the surroundings changed.

Geommugeuk and Geugak Soma stood at the edge of a cliff, with Tu Wang standing a dozen or so paces away.

“My internal energy is all but exhausted. How about a cliff-edge tactic?”

At Geommugeuk’s words, Am Wang made a puzzled expression. Her eyes seemed to say that the Young Cult Leader would never choose such a method.

Geommugeuk turned to Geugak Soma and asked.

“Can you swim well?”

“I can.”

Then Geommugeuk ruthlessly pushed Geugak Soma off the cliff.

“What are you doing?”

Tu Wang did not understand, but Am Wang realized Geommugeuk’s intention.

“You sent Geugak Soma to circulate his true qi for a full cycle and return.”

For once his internal energy was completely exhausted, he would be unable to block their attacks.

“The reason you chose such a cliff is so that we cannot easily find him.”

Admiration flickered in Am Wang’s wavering eyes.

“Anyone could think of such a plan. But it is not easy to conceive of it in the midst of such frantic fighting. The Young Cult Leader is truly clever.”

“You, who read my intent in an instant, are no pushover either.”

“In any case, it is over now. By the time Geugak Soma returns after circulating his true qi, you will already be dead.”

For it had already been proven through the fighting thus far that he could not win alone.

Tu Wang charged again.

One on one.

At the edge of the cliff, fist and sword clashed.

Geommugeuk did not retreat from the cliff’s edge.

He gritted his teeth and fought desperately, yet he could not handle it alone.

In the end, he could not hold out for even thirty moves, and Geommugeuk collapsed on the ground.

Geommugeuk, gasping for breath, appeared to have completely exhausted his internal energy. His hand trembled as he tried to grasp his fallen sword beside him, but ultimately he could not seize it.

Tu Wang approached, looked down at him, and spoke.

“Why didn’t you jump off the cliff and flee?”

Am Wang answered in his stead.

“If you had, we would have jumped after you. Then Geugak Soma might have died. To think you would rather die first—truly impressive.”

Am Wang looked down with admiring eyes and then issued her final order.

“Send the Young Cult Leader on his way first, as he wishes. When the Young Cult Leader dies, the Spacetime Transposition Technique will break, and Geugak Soma will be revealed as well.”

Tu Wang clashed his two fists together and laughed.

Ka-ang! Ka-ang!

Then Tu Wang’s iron chains gleamed. It was not from his fists striking together.

A ray of light flowed along the chains. That light stretched long, traveling up Tu Wang’s body to his face.

In that instant, Tu Wang opened his eyes narrowly. Faint but unmistakable, what entered his eyes was light.

Tu Wang looked up at the sky with a shocked face.

Lines of light began to appear at the sun’s edge. They resembled the rims of Tu Wang’s pupils.

As the moon began to quickly separate from the sun, the world trapped in darkness regained its light.

The solar eclipse had ended in an instant.

At the same time, the world grew dazzlingly bright.

Shock crossed Tu Wang’s face. Am Wang’s expression, still overlapping with his, grew grave. Something that absolutely should not have happened outside the Spacetime Transposition Technique was unfolding.

Lying on the ground, Geommugeuk spoke.

“You said it yourself. Where there is light, darkness must also coexist. But is there not also no such thing as eternal darkness?”

Am Wang answered calmly.

“What a pity. If those outside had succeeded just a little earlier, you might have won, Young Cult Leader.”

“A pity indeed. Under this sun, I could have killed you as well.”

Am Wang gave no answer.

Now that the power sustaining the Dark Descent Technique had been severed, that could truly have been possible.

“Still, I am fortunate to die in a bright place.”

Tu Wang grabbed the collar of the fallen Geommugeuk and hauled him upright.

“You stubborn bastard! This is the end!”

He was the one who had endured all that agony for this very moment.

Kkwak.

Right then, Geommugeuk seized both of Tu Wang’s wrists.

“Struggling is—”

In that instant, Tu Wang’s expression stiffened. Geommugeuk still had internal energy left.

Geommugeuk held him fast so he could not move. Was he pouring out all his remaining internal energy? It was tremendous force. Why had he pretended to have none when he still possessed internal energy?

‘Why on earth?’

Then Am Wang was struck with alarm.

“Surely not!”

The moment Tu Wang instinctively turned his head back.

The last thing he saw was a massive palm.

In that instant when the two overlapping eyes of Tu Wang and Am Wang widened simultaneously.

Swhaaaaaaaa!

Geugak Soma’s Mageuk Gwangpokjang was unleashed right in front of Tu Wang’s face.

POOOOONG!

Tu Wang’s head was swept away by the energy blast.

In truth, Geugak Soma had not completely exhausted his internal energy. He had exactly enough left to unleash the Mageuk Gwangpokjang once.

It was the two’s plan. A life-or-death ruse that could have killed them had it failed.

There was an outcropping below the cliff that Geommugeuk had created for him to stand upon. Geugak Soma had waited there for this very moment when they let their guard down. This moment when they were intoxicated by victory!

And, as if on cue, the plan shone even brighter as the eclipse ended.

The two could be certain. That Tu Wang would never return.

Tu Wang, with everything above his neck completely gone, remained standing.

In the place where Tu Wang’s face had been, Am Wang’s face could be seen instead, standing before them. It was as if Am Wang’s head had been attached to Tu Wang’s body.

Am Wang had escaped from his body just before Tu Wang died. It had been close—too close. They could not have guaranteed withstanding that attack even in the darkness, let alone beneath this sunlight?

It was also the very moment that Geommugeuk’s question hit the mark—whether that black smoke might betray you at some point.

Looking at her, who had been overlapping with Tu Wang all this time, now flickering alone beneath the sunlight, Geommugeuk spoke calmly.

“Now I can see your face properly.”

Chapter 551: So What If I Risk My Life?
---------------------------------------
Jin Hagun and the Demon Extermination Unit were engaged in a bloody battle at the final gate of the Blood Road Maze Formation.

“Watch the left!”

Jin Hagun swung his sword and blocked the hidden weapon flying toward him. From behind, a long spear shot out swiftly, grazed past Jin Hagun’s ear, then withdrew again.

All manner of mechanisms flew in from every direction, targeting the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit. As time passed, the mechanisms attacked with ever greater strength and speed.

“Hurry!”

Jin Hagun’s shout was directed at Jeong Gyeong.

Amid this asura-like chaos, Jeong Gyeong, the Demon Extermination Unit’s formation specialist, was striving to find the life gate of the trial. This gate had to be solved by using the Five Elements’ cycles of mutual generation and mutual restraint.

Stepping stones inscribed with the characters of the Five Elements lay across the floor.

First, it had to be solved using the cycle of mutual generation, and then the cycle of mutual restraint.

“Wood drains the energy of earth, and earth blocks the flow of water.”

Jeong Gyeong stepped in order from Wood (木) to Earth (土), then to Water (水).

The problem was that the formation did not allow this easily.

“Get down!”

At Jin Hagun’s shout, the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit all dropped flat at once.

Whirrrrrrrrr!

An enormous rotating blade passed over their heads at terrifying speed.

Truly, it was clear why this maze formation bore the name “Blood Road.”

“Fire (火) melts metal (金), and metal cuts wood.”

If he was even a little late in stepping onto the floor, he would fall into a death gate. Then they would have to risk their lives to escape again.

‘Done!’

Just as Jeong Gyeong threw himself forward to step on the final stone—

Shwaaaaaak!

A blade aimed for that very moment flew toward Jeong Gyeong. In his joy and excitement, he had been too hasty.

‘No!’

It was too late to dodge, and despair seized him. Even if his neck was cut off, he only hoped his body would continue forward and step on that stone!

Kaaang!

The rotating blade brushed past him. Jin Hagun had rushed in and struck the blade away. There was no time even to exchange thanks.

Jin Hagun charged back in the opposite direction, and Jeong Gyeong threw himself toward the final stepping stone.

After circling through the Five Elements, the instant he stepped on the final Wood (木) stone—

With a clank, every mechanism stopped. One warrior of the Demon Extermination Unit stared at a blade that had barely halted right before his eyes.

The mechanisms that had filled the space with clanging metal from every side began returning to their original places.

Srrrng.

A door hidden in the wall opened. At last, they had opened the life gate of the final trial.

Everyone looked around at one another and exchanged glances. None of them knew how many times they had truly crossed the threshold of death.

“You worked hard.”

Jin Hagun praised Jeong Gyeong.

“Not at all. If it weren’t for you, Unit Leader, we truly would have lost many comrades.”

All the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit nodded in agreement. Jin Hagun’s performance in this formation had been that outstanding. It was an opportunity for them to see him anew.

“Let’s get out for now.”

They had not yet killed Cheongoe, who had deployed the formation. Since the formation had been broken, once they passed through that door, he would show himself.

Just as they were about to enter the door, Cheongoe’s voice rang out.

“To break through all the way to the final gate without a single sacrifice… truly impressive.”

His voice echoed, making it impossible to tell where it came from.

“The Demon Extermination Unit. You are indeed worthy of being called the pride of the Martial Alliance.”

Jin Hagun felt an ominous chill. Even though they had broken through the final gate, there was leisure in the bastard’s voice.

“But it would be a shame to let you go just like that, so I prepared a parting gift.”

Clank. Clank. Clank. Clank. Clank.

More than ten doors opened from every direction. Beyond them were long corridors, and at the end of each corridor, people were bound. Some places held one person, while others held several.

“Please save me!”

“Please, help us!”

“Please, at least save my child!”

Dozens of blades were aimed above their heads. They trembled in terror, not knowing when those blades might fall.

Cheongoe’s voice sounded again.

“It won’t be easy to save them.”

Jin Hagun could tell. Each corridor where those people were trapped had dangerous mechanisms hidden within it.

Srrrrrrk.

In front of the life gate ahead, something rose from the floor. It was the scale that showed the time limit, the same as they had seen at the previous gate.

“If you fail to leave through that life gate within the time limit, you will have to break through the Blood Road Maze Formation from the beginning again—only this time, it will be even stronger. Horrifying, isn’t it? Perhaps not all of you will make it this far alive as you did now.”

If the maze had grown stronger, there would be many casualties. Even getting here like this had been far from easy.

“Everyone you fail to save will die. Now then, how many can you save? Who will be chosen by the proud Demon Extermination Unit?”

It was a statement that meant everyone else would die. Cheongoe was behaving like a true devil.

“You will live with guilt for the rest of your lives!”

Along with Cheongoe’s laughter, the scale began to operate, and time started flowing.

Judging by the speed at which the scale tilted, there was not much time.

Inside the corridors, everyone shouted for them to save them.

“There are eight people in that room. We should save the places with the most people first.”

“No. There’s a child in this room. We should save this side first!”

The warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit each reported the situation in the rooms.

Their gazes turned toward Jin Hagun. Deciding whom to save was an incredibly difficult choice. By his order, someone would live, and someone else would die. Even as this happened, the scale continued tilting.

Then Jin Hagun spoke quietly.

“There’s no need to agonize over whom to save.”

At Jin Hagun’s words, everyone looked at him in surprise.

Jin Hagun strode forward and closed, with his own hands, the door of the life gate through which they were meant to escape.

Boom.

After closing the door, Jin Hagun turned around and said to his subordinates,

“We save them all, and then we start this formation over from the beginning!”

“!”

Because it was a decision they had not expected, everyone looked shocked.

Jin Hagun went from room to room and shouted to them,

“We will save all of you, so please wait calmly!”

At that, sighs of relief came from each corridor.

Jin Hagun spoke again to his subordinates of the Demon Extermination Unit.

“Someone may call this decision foolish. Some of us may die. Perhaps all of us may die. But I believe this choice is what makes us different from the Demonic Cult and the evil sects.”

A look of apology crossed Jin Hagun’s face. He respectfully cupped his fist and bowed his head to his subordinates.

“I am sorry for not giving you the chance to choose. I will make my apology in the underworld.”

The warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit looked at one another once.

Clack, clack, clack, clack, clack, clack.

They all drew their swords at once and shouted,

“Exterminate demons and shatter evil! The path of chivalrous righteousness!”

From the very beginning, they had no intention whatsoever of defying the decision of their leader, Jin Hagun. If the leader of the Demon Extermination Unit told them to die, then dying was what the Demon Extermination Unit did.

Just as they were about to enter the first room to save the people—

Sssssss.

Everything around them began to vanish. The open doors, and the people who had been waiting desperately.

Now they were in a different plaza.

Incense burned in every direction, and the walls and floor were filled with all manner of incomprehensible characters.

At the center sat Cheongoe.

The look in Cheongoe’s eyes as he stared at Jin Hagun was filled with disbelief.

“You truly chose to close the life gate with your own hands?”

Blood streamed from his mouth.

The instant they saw that, Jin Hagun and the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit understood. The formation had been broken. And as the formation was destroyed, Cheongoe had suffered severe internal injuries.

Closing the door of the life gate with one’s own hands.

Astonishingly, that choice had been the method to completely destroy this Blood Road Maze Formation.

The room with a child, the room with many people to save—all those various situations had been traps. They were meant to make them agonize over whom to save, so they would fail to see the essence.

“You truly stayed in this maze formation to save people you don’t even know?”

To that question full of doubt, Jin Hagun answered calmly.

“It may be surprising to you, but to us, it is only natural.”

Cheongoe did not believe him. Looking at him as though he were a hypocrite, he asked again,

“Leader of the Demon Extermination Unit, were you always this kind of person?”

Jin Hagun could not answer that question. He found himself thinking that he did not really know either. Had he truly been this kind of person? Or had something changed him?

“Someone once told me, ‘You will become a magnificent Alliance Leader.’ So I am trying to become one.”

Jin Hagun drew his sword. Then the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit also drew their swords in unison and aimed them at Cheongoe.

Whooooo.

Though no wind blew, the sound of wind arose. Light burst forth from the bizarre patterns and characters on the floor.

Shiiik!

Jin Hagun released sword qi. But as if he were cutting through an illusion, the sword qi passed right through Cheongoe.

At that moment, Hwang Ju, who was skilled in sorcery, shouted,

“You must enter the circle he is sitting in and cut him directly!”

Indeed, Cheongoe was seated at the center of a circle filled with incomprehensible spells.

Just as Jin Hagun was about to launch himself toward him—

Swaaaaaaaaaa.

A terrible evil energy swept in like a storm.

Cheongoe had drawn up the last of his internal energy to unleash his secret sorcery.

Heart Demon Black Shadow Art!

In that instant, the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit flinched. Some spat curses, and some screamed.

Illusions appeared before all of them. They were the people and events hidden deepest within their hearts. Things they all wished to conceal.

“Everyone, recite the verses of the Righteous Heart Art!”

It was a mind cultivation art unique to the Martial Alliance, one that protected the heart from wicked sorcery.

As they recited the Righteous Heart Art, the illusions in their hearts vanished and reappeared over and over again.

When the Demon Extermination Unit resisted with the Righteous Heart Art, other patterns and characters around Cheongoe began to glow. This time, they shone in many brilliant colors.

Srrrrrrk.

Then shadows holding swords rose from the floor.

Hwang Ju shouted again,

“They are shadow ghosts! Extinguish the candles on all sides!”

The Demon Extermination warriors swung their swords as one and faced the shadow ghosts. When their blades collided with the shadow swords the ghosts swung, the sound of metal rang out.

Clang, clang, clang, clang!

Those beings might have been illusions, but the swords they held were real.

Even as the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit fought the shadow ghosts, they recited the Righteous Heart Art and struggled to extinguish the candles. The shadow ghosts attacked them desperately, trying by any means to stop them.

As battles erupted in every direction, Jin Hagun was advancing toward Cheongoe.

Shwaaaaaaaaaa.

An immense evil energy battered him.

His skin was tearing, and it was so difficult that he could barely breathe, but Jin Hagun recited the Righteous Heart Art and silently moved forward.

The shadow ghosts that tried to attack him were blocked desperately by the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit.

The closer he drew to Cheongoe, the more illusions appeared, shaking his heart. The illusion of his grandfather disturbed his mind.

—I do not regard you as my successor! Do you think you are qualified to inherit my position?

His grandfather glared at him with terrifying eyes. It was such a vivid illusion that his heart ached with resentment.

Jin Hagun recited the Righteous Heart Art and continued forward. The next person to appear was his younger sister.

—Brother, you are a hypocrite. All this effort to uphold chivalrous righteousness is ultimately for the purpose of becoming the Martial Alliance Leader, isn’t it? Why do you think your chivalry has become exhausting? It is because of this impure purpose.

He knew this too was an illusion created by sorcery, but it hurt his heart.

Clang, clang, clang!

The sound of swords clashing rang by his ears. He thought that if the warriors of the Demon Extermination Unit had not been blocking for him, he would have been bewitched by these illusions and allowed those attacks to land.

This time, the figure of the child he had once saved appeared again.

—Even if it meant giving up the position of Alliance Leader, would you still save me?

Then, immediately, an image arose of people pointing fingers at him after he failed to become the successor.

—Just how incompetent must he have been, for his grandfather to be the Alliance Leader and yet still not inherit the position?

And what hurt his heart most in all these illusions was this:

‘Is the desire to become the Martial Alliance Leader all there is in my heart?’

That must be why it was burrowing into that feeling and attacking him. That fact disappointed him in himself. The fact that his desire to become Alliance Leader lay in the deepest part of him.

Like a money-grubber who had sold his soul for wealth, like a lecher who had sold his soul to lust—had he sold his soul to power?

He knew that making him feel this way was what the illusion was aiming for. Even knowing that, he was tormented. No, because he knew, he was tormented all the more.

Hiiiiiii.

The closer he drew to Cheongoe, the more the wicked energy reached its peak. His head swam and dizziness overtook him. He wanted to simply sink to the ground and give up on everything.

If there was a Jin Hagun suffering like that, then in another corner of his heart—

‘Don’t make me laugh! I’ll never lose to some sorcery like this!’

There was also a Jin Hagun gritting his teeth.

That Jin Hagun kept thinking of one person. He did not know why that person was Geom Mugeuk, but in this extreme moment, he needed him.

—I’ll overcome it too, just like you.

Then Geom Mugeuk’s answer seemed to ring out. If it were him, he would say something like this at a time like this.

—I told you not to try too hard. Trust only as much as an arm’s length, and do only as well as an arm’s length.

Thinking of Geom Mugeuk, Jin Hagun gritted his teeth and stepped forward.

He walked and walked. And at the moment he took another step, prepared even for his body to be torn apart—

The terrible demonic energy pressing down on him vanished all at once, as if it had been a lie. The distracting thoughts tormenting his mind vanished with it.

And before his eyes, Cheongoe was vomiting blood in great heaves. His internal injuries were too deep; there was no turning back now.

Jin Hagun had overcome Cheongoe’s Heart Demon Black Shadow Art by his will alone.

Cheongoe looked up at him venomously.

“You’ve staked your life on becoming Alliance Leader, haven’t you? Your chivalrous righteousness is nothing but a tool to become Alliance Leader.”

Even at the moment of death, he sought to leave a wound on his opponent. Jin Hagun said nothing to that malice.

Shiiiiik!

Thuk!

Jin Hagun’s sword pierced Cheongoe’s heart.

Without pulling out his sword, Jin Hagun spoke without looking back at his subordinates.

“What he said may be true.”

He honestly told his subordinates what he had not said to the man.

A brief silence flowed.

Then someone behind him spoke.

“What’s wrong with staking your life on it?”

When Jin Hagun turned his head to look back, it was Jeong Gyeong. He thought Jeong Gyeong was saying such a thing because Jin Hagun had saved him several times while breaking through the formation.

Hwang Ju took up his words.

“I would rather you did. I hope that desire comes before chivalrous righteousness or goodwill.”

Was it because of what he had shown within the formation?

Even at the words that he wanted the position of Alliance Leader more than chivalry, the warriors of the Demon-Exterminating Squad showed no particular agitation. Rather, some even said this.

“I don’t think ambition is bad either. I want to accomplish a great cause with someone like that.”

Perhaps because they thought it was the first chance they had ever had, even those taciturn men who seemed unlikely to speak each said a word.

“You have done so well until now. How could you do any better?”

“I think anything beyond that would be greed.”

“If you are too perfect, it makes things difficult for us.”

Jin Hagun had truly never imagined his subordinates would say such things to him. He had not known they held such thoughts.

Come to think of it, we have never once spoken openly and honestly. Even though we have shared life and death like this.

After silently gazing at his subordinates for a moment, Jin Hagun turned back to Cheongoe.

Cheongoe’s wide-open eyes had completely lost their light.

“Yes. I have staked my life on becoming Alliance Leader.”

Jin Hagun pulled out the sword embedded in Cheongoe’s heart.

Spurrrt.

Jin Hagun did not avoid the blood that sprayed over his body.

As the lifeless Cheongoe slowly collapsed sideways, the surroundings began to change.

Thud.

The place where Cheongoe fell was the courtyard of Cheonhwaru.

And so, under everyone’s watchful eyes, Jin Hagun and the Demon-Exterminating Squad returned.

Chapter 552: A Pitch-Black Hole in My Heart Too.
------------------------------------------------
Beneath the blazing sunlight, the Dark King was wavering perilously, as if she might vanish at any moment.

But Geom Mugeuk knew. She was not an opponent who would simply disappear into nothingness like this.

“It cost an enormous sum to save that man. What a shame.”

Even in this situation, she maintained her composure.

Geom Mugeuk looked at Geugak Soma and said,

“I should have blown off only half his head and sent him back alive. So they’d go bankrupt trying to save him.”

As he joked, Geom Mugeuk’s hand naturally touched Geugak Soma’s back.

Wooooong.

Internal energy began to flow stealthily into Geugak Soma. He was trying to share a portion of what remained of his internal energy with him.

Geugak Soma did not refuse and accepted the energy. The Dark King might target him now that his internal energy had run out. If so, Geom Mugeuk would try to protect him.

If that energy was going to be spent that way, it was better to pass it to him instead. As always, he trusted the Young Cult Leader’s choice.

“We wouldn’t have saved him twice. Even that one time, our opinions were divided.”

“Which side were you on? Ah, of course you must have been on the side that wanted to save him.”

The wavering shadow shook her head. Though she had come with the Fighting King, it seemed she had hoped he would not be saved.

“You were the one who rescued him, weren’t you?”

“I was only following orders.”

It was likely not a lie. To her, who lived in the world of night, all those who lived in the day would hold no meaning.

Was the one who gave the order Hwa Mugi? Or someone else?

Geom Mugeuk wanted to ask directly about Hwa Mugi. What was he doing now? Was he still the leader of these people at this point in time? What was he thinking?

But he had no intention of mentioning Hwa Mugi at all. Many things had already changed in this life, but even so, he would not touch that matter to the end.

Because he hoped that Hwa Mugi, at least, would appear at that future time according to his original fate. Because the ones who should face him were not the present them, but the future them.

Instead of asking about him, he asked about the Dark King.

“If you disappear from here, what happens to your true body? Does it die in the palanquin?”

Geom Mugeuk thought her real body must be inside the palanquin.

“Why do you assume I will lose to the Young Cult Leader?”

“Because we have no intention of losing.”

“The Demon Venerable’s internal energy must be exhausted, and you, Young Cult Leader, should have little internal energy left to maintain this Space-Time Transposition Art, no?”

Indeed, the sunlight that had been shining fiercely was gradually losing its brilliance. Unable to maintain the blazing sun, he was now allowing time in this place to flow.

“To be honest, even this much is truly astonishing. No matter if you are the successor of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult, how did you gather such internal energy at your age?”

Geom Mugeuk truly displayed profound power that seemed without end.

“I am the incarnation of greed. So I had thought this much would be enough, but from now on, I intend to gather much more. I made up my mind after meeting you. When it comes to internal energy and martial arts, I must not be the incarnation of greed, but greed itself. Only then will I be able to face you people.”

In the meantime, all the internal energy had been transmitted to Geugak Soma. Even while conversing, Geom Mugeuk had displayed the divine feat of passing on internal energy without his opponent noticing.

Geom Mugeuk drew the Black Demon Sword. As though it had been tempered by the Fighting King’s fist, an even sharper edge of killing intent flowed along the blade.

“Now, let’s finish this. I have a banquet appointment with my friends.”

Geom Mugeuk did not lose his composure.

Geugak Soma, too, gazed at the Dark King with calm eyes, both arms hanging at his sides.

The Dark King’s gaze turned toward the two of them, then toward the sun behind them. In that brief time, it had descended quite a bit more.

The moment her eyes grew intense, black smoke whirled around her and rose into the air.

Where the smoke vanished, a woman stood. Astonishingly, the Dark King had been here, not in the palanquin.

“It won’t be a banquet. It will be the memorial day for all of you.”

A woman dressed in black martial robes.

Her appearance was the complete opposite of her voice. Her features protruded, were torn and unbalanced; she had, in truth, looked far more beautiful when she had been wavering.

Her voice was different as well. A grating, shrill voice that jarred the ears.

“You damned son of a bitch Young Cult Leader!”

As if this were her original personality, her two eyes were filled only with deep hatred.

“I think I understand why you descended into that person’s body to fight.”

Killing intent flashed through the Dark King’s eyes. She had expected mockery that it was because of her appearance, but Geom Mugeuk was looking at something else.

“You are someone with a strong desire to live.”

She did not deny it. When she descended into someone, even if that vessel died, she herself did not. But now that her body was revealed, it was different. She could truly die.

“Even if I die, I won’t die in this filthy world of yours!”

The Dark King launched a surprise attack, striking out with both palms.

Shwaaaaaak.

She thought Geom Mugeuk would dodge, but Geugak Soma, who had no internal energy, would not be able to.

Yet Geugak Soma evaded her attack and even counterattacked.

Shuk!

She barely avoided the Blood Calamity Finger that flew at her.

She had been the one to launch the surprise attack, yet she was the one more startled. The Dark King shouted irritably,

“You monstrous bastards! Where the hell does your internal energy come from?”

Shwaaaaaaak!

The ground overturned beneath her palm technique. The cliff they stood on shook as if it might collapse at any moment.

But the martial arts she displayed in a place that was not darkness were nothing more and nothing less than “impressive.” Merely impressive was not enough to catch Geom Mugeuk and Geugak Soma.

Compensating for her lacking skill with internal energy, she continued the fierce battle.

And from the very beginning of this fight, the moment she had been waiting for arrived.

As Geom Mugeuk approached her, he suddenly looked at his hand. A reddish hue was seeping into it. In the distance, the sunset had begun to fall—the hour of dog and wolf, when day and night crossed.

And this moment was the hour of the wolf.

For an instant, it seemed a white rim formed once more around her pupils.

Then her body changed back into a shadow of darkness.

Srrrk.

In that instant, she vanished from sight.

Geom Mugeuk was startled. He had never seen movement this fast before.

“She seems to have used the Dark Path Return Art!”

He had thought she would not be able to use it here!

Geom Mugeuk turned toward Geugak Soma, then flinched in shock.

Geom Mugeuk’s eyes sank coldly. She had not used the Dark Path Return Art.

The Dark King’s face was wavering over Geugak Soma’s mask.

The Dark King had descended into Geugak Soma’s body.

From the moment the fight began, she had aimed for only this single instant. The instant when the light disappeared and she could use the Dark Descent Art.

It would have been better if she could have descended into Geom Mugeuk’s body, but she could not descend into the body of Geom Mugeuk, who had trained in the Nine Flowers Demon Art and the Heavenly Demon Body-Protecting Art.

Geom Mugeuk stared at Geugak Soma in shock. Geugak Soma’s eyes were also startled. It meant that though his body had been controlled, his mind had not. Even with the Fighting King, the two had remained separate.

“One cannot use the Dark Descent Art twice in a single day.”

Her voice had once again become alluring and beautiful.

“If one does, a curse descends. What curse might that be?”

She continued with shocking words.

“It is the curse of never being able to escape the body one has descended into. I will be with Geugak Soma forever.”

“Don’t talk nonsense!”

Geom Mugeuk did not believe her. If such a curse existed, she would never have used the descent art.

Her clear, ringing laughter echoed out. She truly laughed like a madwoman.

“That’s right, it is nonsense. I simply cannot leave this body for the next three days. Until then, we live together and die together. That is more than enough time to kill all of you.”

Geom Mugeuk looked into Geugak Soma’s eyes beneath her wavering gaze. Rather, the eyes of the one directly involved were calm.

But his body was being controlled by the Dark King.

Shuk!

Blood Calamity Finger shot from Geugak Soma’s finger. His hand and the wavering shadow of the Dark King overlapped as they moved. Geugak Soma could not control his own body. That was because the internal energy of the descended Dark King was greater.

Geom Mugeuk threw himself aside and avoided the Blood Calamity Finger. He had never imagined a situation would come where he had to dodge Geugak Soma’s Blood Calamity Finger.

Shuk! Shuk!

Geom Mugeuk threw himself aside again. The Blood Calamity Finger grazed past his side.

“No!”

Despite Geugak Soma’s cry, the Blood Calamity Finger instead split apart and aimed for Geom Mugeuk.

Pak! Pak!

Blood burst from Geom Mugeuk’s shoulder. Once the Dark King descended into Geugak Soma, the power of the Blood Calamity Finger became even faster and stronger. For Geom Mugeuk, whose internal energy was exhausted, it was nothing short of a calamity.

“Do not worry, Lord Soma! I will find a way!”

Even while dodging the Blood Calamity Finger, Geom Mugeuk instead reassured Geugak Soma. But no method came to mind.

He could not release the Space-Time Transposition Art.

He could not know the situation outside, and even if Jin Hagun and Bisain were waiting for him, he could not attack Geugak Soma.

What worried him more than anything was the possibility that she would disappear with Geugak Soma using the Dark Path Return Art.

If Geugak Soma were dragged away by them like this?

They would kill Geugak Soma miserably. And if they kept him alive, his fate would be more wretched than death.

Puh-uk!

The Blood Calamity Finger bent and split apart, spraying blood from Geom Mugeuk’s body once more.

Geugak Soma shouted,

“Release the Space-Time Transposition Art, Young Cult Leader!”

He meant for him to join forces with the comrades outside.

‘At this rate, the Young Cult Leader will die.’

But Geom Mugeuk did not release it.

Geugak Soma thought there was only one way to resolve this situation.

“Young Cult Leader, you must kill me.”

The Dark King laughed and said,

“I know how much the Young Cult Leader cherishes you. The Young Cult Leader will never be able to kill you.”

Geom Mugeuk nodded and admitted it.

“I would rather die myself than do that. Please wait. I will find a way!”

Of course, Geugak Soma believed in Geom Mugeuk.

But right now, there was no time and no internal energy.

At this rate, he would die here. The killing intent of the Dark King lodged in his body was firm, and Geom Mugeuk would never attack him.

Geugak Soma’s eyes deepened as he resolved himself to something.

Shuk shuk shuk!

Puk! Puk!

Because he was using his remaining internal energy to maintain the Space-Time Transposition Art, Geom Mugeuk continued to be wounded. He avoided fatal injuries, but Geom Mugeuk’s entire body was soaked in blood.

Whiriririk.

Black smoke rose from beneath Geom Mugeuk’s feet like vines and bound his body. Injured and exhausted, Geom Mugeuk could not shake off that energy. Even in this situation, Geom Mugeuk did not release the Space-Time Transposition Art.

“Now, I’ll finish you with the very move that blew off that man’s head.”

The moment she raised her hand to unleash the Demon Extreme Berserk Palm.

The Dark King’s eyes widened in shock.

“!”

Only her wavering arm had stretched forward.

Geugak Soma’s arm remained where it was. His body had rejected her.

‘He can withstand the command of descent? How?’

It was something the Dark King had never experienced even once.

The Dark King tried to control him again and make him move. But Geugak Soma did not budge. Red veins burst in the two eyes within the mask.

And that was not all.

Geugak Soma’s arm began to rise slowly. He was not merely rejecting the Dark King; he was moving on his own.

Geugak Soma’s mind was filled entirely with white. He was now standing in his room. Standing there, staring at the long line drawn across the wall. The power of darkness could not invade the mind of Geugak Soma, who stood in the midst of pure white.

The place Geugak Soma’s hand was headed was not toward Geom Mugeuk. It was rising toward his own head. Since she had said she could not leave this body for three days, he intended to die together with the Dark King.

“No! Lord Soma! You mustn’t!”

Despite Geom Mugeuk’s cry, Geugak Soma’s arm continued to rise.

“Lord Soma! Soma, no!”

Though Geom Mugeuk shouted, the arm kept rising.

The Dark King was desperate as well. If Geugak Soma died, she too would die.

Black energy flowed out and tried to stop him, but it could not overcome Geugak Soma’s will.

The power Geugak Soma displayed now surpassed human will.

“Release this! Hurry!”

Without hesitation, the Dark King released the energy binding Geom Mugeuk. First, she had to survive.

The very instant the palm was heading toward Geugak Soma’s white mask—

Grip.

Geom Mugeuk seized his arm and turned the palm toward himself. By a hair’s breadth, the Demon Extreme Berserk Palm was not unleashed.

Geom Mugeuk and Geugak Soma’s gazes tangled in midair. The two asked and answered with their eyes.

Are you truly going to do this?

Yes. If it means I can save the Young Cult Master, I will.

Yes, he would. Just as I will not give up on him, he will not give up on me. That is why I have to find another way.

Geom Mugeuk’s gaze turned to the Dark King’s wavering shadow.

‘If only I could grab that!’

Geom Mugeuk seized that arm.

But it slipped through his hand like smoke.

He grabbed and grabbed again, but the shadow could not be caught.

‘Please! Please!’

When that desperation reached its peak, Geom Mugeuk’s body responded.

Wooooong!

With a deep vibration, something that had only been sleeping within his body until now awakened.

The energy that Bigwe had absorbed began to move. Among it, the energy now stirring was none other than the Black Crystal’s power.

As the Black Crystal’s energy rushed into Geom Mugeuk’s hands, black energy began to ripple around them as well.

Clench.

The next moment, the Dark King’s wrist was caught in Geom Mugeuk’s hand.

The Dark King was shocked, and so was Geom Mugeuk. The Dark King’s astonished expression rippled over the white mask. Beneath it, within the eyeholes, Geugak Soma’s eyes also shone with surprise.

“I caught you!”

Geom Mugeuk gripped the Dark King’s hand tightly. The Dark King tried to shake him off, but how could Geom Mugeuk ever let go of that hand? He pulled with the resolve that he would not release it even if his arm were severed.

Riiiiip.

Her body began to be dragged out of Geugak Soma.

“Lord Soma! Back!”

Geugak Soma exerted force in the opposite direction, trying to free himself from her.

“……Impossible!”

The dark energy flowing from her shocked body clawed at Geom Mugeuk’s arm.

Pak! Pak!

Blood sprayed from his arm, but Geom Mugeuk did not let go of her hand. Fortunately, the supreme-grade Heavenly Silkworm Thread wrapped around his arm prevented it from being cut.

Geom Mugeuk had only one thought: if he let go of this hand, Geugak Soma would die.

“Just a little more! Just a little more! Uaaaaaaah!”

Riiiiip.

Little by little, she was pulled out.

And the very moment the Dark King was completely separated from Geugak Soma’s body—

Hwaaaaak! Sarak!

The Black Crystal’s energy devoured that darkness in an instant, as if swallowing it whole.

“Aaaaaagh!”

At the same time, her original form was revealed.

Geom Mugeuk was just as shocked as she was. Her dark energy had already been absorbed by the Black Crystal’s power, and then, as if nothing had happened, it lay dormant within his body.

“……No!”

Her face, having completely lost its dark energy, turned pitch-black in an instant.

Psssss.

She became black ash and scattered into the air.

Geom Mugeuk, who had been staring blankly at the sight, collapsed onto his back as if falling.

Geugak Soma also lay down where he was.
